tei:div.tei:p: tha mal pa'i rtog paphal pa'i rnam pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ /sgom pa lhar/yang dag rab tu grags| |rang bzhin gnas skabs gzhom pa ni/ /bsgom pa ma yin bsgom pa min/ /phal rdzogs rim

| pa'i gnas mtha' gsum gyis ma reg skabs gzhom pa'i phyir/ /bskyed pa lha/sgom pa'ang ni sgom rdzogs rim gyis/pa min/ /nam zhes zhus pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rtogs pa khyed rang gis sngar bstan pa/de bzhin te/ /tha mal pa/ 'on kyang mi ma dag pa'i zer/gtsang ba'i tshad mnyam par tha mal pa'i rtog pa/sbyang ba'i phyir| |sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bskyed pa/ bsgom par bya'o/ /phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lus can lhar/bsgom pa'i thabs kyi dgos pa nyid de ci lags/ bcom 'on te gzhan yang yod ce na/ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po dgos pa gzhan yang*/yod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dgos pa de'i/ming ci lags/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ sangs gzugs sku'i/rgyas nyid do| |da lta gzugs sku bsgom pas 'bras bu gzugs sku thob pa'i dgos pa yod do//sangs rgyas nyid de ci lags/ rten dang brten pa tha mi dad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /de ci lags/ye shes kyi snang ba'i gzugs sku/lus can 'di ye shes kyi snang ba'i sku/ni cis kyang 'byung*/bden pa'o/ /rgyu ci'i slad du zhe na/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ 'di ltar nga ni mtshan 'bras bu dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung ba dgag pa/ sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan zhing*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'o/ / de'i phyir bskyed pa bsgom pa'o//de ci'i slad du zhe na/ tha mal pa'i gzugs dang*/mi 'dra ba'i phyir bsgrub par lam gyi dus su bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa/bya ba yin no/ /phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ ci bcom ldan 'das mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i phyir/bems po lags sam/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ bems po ma yin te nga nyid mtshan dpe dang ldan pa nyid/me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /la sogs pa'i snang ba yin/me long lta bu'i ye shes de ci lags/

rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ bden rigs pas dpyad na/ pa ma yin pa ste/ kun rdzob tu longs skus sprul pa lta bur/brdzun pa ma yin pa dang*/ blang ba zer/ rgyu zag bcas kyi/ma yin pa dang*/ dor ba zer/skye las dang nyon mongs pa las/ba ma yin pa dang*| de ltar nga nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang*/ nga nyid so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ nga nyid bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes dang*/ de ltar chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /snang ba ma yin pas bems po ma yin/de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnam pa gzugs sku/dang bral ba'i byang chub de skad ma smra zhig nga nyid gzugs sku/ dngos po dngos chos sku/ med nga*/ /dang po nas rang bzhin gyis gnas pa|de bzhin gshegs sems nyid skye ba med/par brjod/ /gzugs gzugs skur snang bas/ dang gzugs med ldan pa'i mchog /zab chos sku/ mo zhi ba'i gzugs dang ldan/ / sems gzugs sku'i cha nas/dpa' chen po he ru ka /bdag dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i brdar/med lhan cig mnyam sbyor nga*/ /bde ba/chen po'i ngo bo yin pas/las ni bems min nga*/ /'jig rten kun gzugs skur snang ba'i ngos nas/rdzob bems po nga*/ / skyes pa bud med ma ning nga*/ /'gro ba nga yis yang dag khyab/ /de chos sku dang gzugs sku dbyer med/phyir snang stong dbyer med/'dus pa zhes bya nyid/ /rgyal ba rgya mtshor thams cad gnyis med ye shes su/bdag gis bshad/ /rdo rje can dang byang sems rnams/ /ma skyes pa ste thabs dang bud med de shes rab yin te thabs shes gnyis dbyer med/ ning go 'phang*/ gnas su yang dag grub/ /gang zhig lha mo bdag med/ma de/ /rang bzhin gyis ni btsun mo min/ /ye shes kyis ni de ltar rang snang gi chung ma lta bu/sangs rgyas he ru ka nga yab/ min| |de nyid phyir na skyes pa dang bud med spangs pa/ma ning ste/ /gnyis par snang ba de ni thabs dang shes rab bo ma ning ni dbyer med do//'gro ba dngos po thabs shes rab/gnyis mthong nas|

|thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid nga*/ /shin thabs shes dbyer med/ tu mnyam sbyor rnal 'byor gyis/ /mi bskyod med cing bdag mar rtogs pa/'ang med/ /dam thabs shes dbyer med/pa'i rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpa' nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rgyal bas/bo chen po ye shes/rdo rje 'dod pa bde mngon du byas pa/ba chen po rdo rje rten pa/yan lag med pa shin tu dga' ba chen pos mngon du byed pa/tshig 'di dag bka' stsal pa/bsnyen pa'i dus su me long dang kaṃ kel+la mya ngan med pa/ gnyis bor phyag bzhi/ sgrub pa'i dus su de gnyis yod pas drug gsung*/ phyag bzhi pa drug zer/dang sgeg gar dgu pas/ par bcas/ /snying khar zla ba la hūm̐ bsams nas mchod pa dang bstod pa'i bar du kha bskang*/ de nas byang chub pa lnga'i rim pas sa bon dang ral gri'i mtshan ma yongs su gyur pa las/ zhal gcig ral pa 'dzin pa dang*/ /brgyad gnyis lo dang ser po ni/ /rdo rje yan rtogs pa'i/lag med pa bsgrub/ /dpa' rtog pa'i g.yul las ( rgyal bas ) bo'i g.yas kyi dang po/par mda' nyid de/ /lag pa gnyis par ral gri nyid/ /gsum par me long rig par bya/ /lag pa g.yon gyi dang po/ par gzhu nyid de/ /gnyis pa la ni dbang mchog ut+pal dmar po/nyid/ /kaṃ kel+la yi mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga ste/ /phyag sgrub pa'i dus su/drug nyid du bsgom par bya/ / zhabs g.yon brkyang pas gnas par ni/ /bu ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ de nas bzlas pa'o| |de nas yang bu mo dgug pa'i las byed na/mo'i snying khar bsams nas ni/ /rdo rje yan lag med pa'i/btsun mo dgug pa'i las/'grub par 'gyur/ /mda' yis so so'i gnas nas|'o ma 'dzin pa 'bigs/ /par bsam/a sho mya ngan med pa/ka yis snying khar brab// ral btsun mo 'ong du mi 'dod na/gris skyes ma bsdigs par bya/ /de nas 'gro phyogs mi shes pa rnams la lam bstan/me long bstan par bya/

/gzhu yis rkang pa bcings nas ni| |ut+pal la'i/zhags pas dgug par bya/ /de ltar byas pas chags pa skyes pa'i rtags/skra grol 'ong so so'i gnas nas/ bar 'dod pa dang*/ /snyan pa'i skad ni rab tu smra| |ha dang dal bar rgyu ba'i rlung*/sī ni byed pa mo/ /rangs chags pa'i rtags/shing yan lag tsher ba spus/mas brgyan/ kha ni so rtsis bkang ba dang*/ /'dod pas myos nas lus| stobs dang bral ba bsam/ /de dang gnyis/rdo rje mchod pa'i snyoms 'jugasbyor ba yis| |mi mi rtog pa/'gyur sems kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po mngon du byas pa'i bsam pas/rjes chags bya/ /'dod pa'i sngags ni ma bcos pas/ /de yi snying ni sgrub par byed pa/bskul bar bya/ /oṃ a che ge mo/mu kā mā kar+ṣa khug cigaya mañdzu gho ṣa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/hrīḥdzaḥde ltar lha/bsgom pa dang sngags bzlas pa/byas pa yis/ / 'jam pa'i dpal/mgon po'i btsun mo ni/ /bsgrub pa po la 'dod pa dang*/ / dbang du byed cing 'ong bar 'gyur/ /zla ba phyed sgrub pa'i dus/kyi sbyor ba yis/ /zla phyed kyi/bzlas pa nyin re la/khri yi sbyor ba las/ /g.yo ba gser gyi rna cha ma/ /shin tu dga' ba'i sems kyis bsgrub/ /haṃ gi sa bon las skyes pa/ /thams cad rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /chang de sgrub tsa na/gi btung ba'i rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje yan lag med pa bsgrub/ /mtshan ma'am rtog pas/ma yang na gtum mo dang thag ring bas/bcom mchog gi de'i rtogs bon haṃ/ni/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rang thams cad la has khyab/ bzhin can/ /haṃ gi nang gi byang sems bde ba chen po mchog tu zhi/ /dang ldan pa ste rtsa'o// sems can thams cad dga' bar byed/ /'di ni haṃ gi nang gi nang na mo/srog ni chen po ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba mdzes pa nyid/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rtag tu de'i/ / haṃ gis khyab/ dran pa de ltar rab tu grags/ /mya ngan 'dod chags de bzhin gdungs|

|dga' dang dga' bral de bzhin no/ /de has khyab/rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes de'i rten yin pas haṃ la bya/rgyal po che/ /de nyid sa bon btu ba/dbyangs yig drug pa.ū/ sa brjod/ /zla ba phyed pa yang dag ldan/ /thig les mgo bo nyid du mchod/ /hūm̐/ thugs rab tu dgyes par gyur te/ sems can kun gyi kun sems kyi rten/gzhi ste/ /rgyud rnams kyi ni rten yin/ khyad par du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi sems chen po rdo rje sa bon gyi yi ge hūm̐ gi che ba/ thos nas/ sems gsal ba bsgrub pa nye bar gyur nas/le'u gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi gar dang 'brel ba/tshig 'di dag gsungs pa/ sems mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i/dpa' ( pa ) med cing bsgom pa med/ /phyi rol gyi/sngags dbyings kyi dbang du byas nas brtags pa dang bral ba'ang ye shes kyi dbang du byas nas rtog pa dang bral ba gnyis sbyar/med lha yang bskyed rim/med pa ste/ /sems kyi rdo skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin las/ rje las byung ba/ /'di ni byang chub thob par byed pa'i lam gyi/ rim brtan pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rigs kyi bla mar bya ba las mi 'da' bas/ dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /bsod nams kyang*/med cing sdig par zhen/pa'ang med/ / byang chub med cing sangs rgyas de nyid/ med/ /ye shes lnga yi ngo bo yin/sbyor ba yis// byang chub sems 'di rtog pas mi g.yo/brtan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo'i dam tshig gis/ de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /sngags phyi rol/med bzlas pa'ang yod ma yin/ /'gro ba gsum po thams cad du zhen pa/med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /bsgom pa mtha' gnyis kyi ma rig pa/dang ni sgom pa med/ /bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /kun rdzob 'jig rten pa yang yod/

/dpyad rigs pas/ na gang du 'jig rten pa/ /rtag tu 'jig rten pa yang dag tu zhen pa/nyid 'khor/ /'di ni byang chub rim bstan pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /don dam par| ma skyes pa dang mtshan ma/mi dmigs pa/ /mi mtshan ma'am rtog pas/ phyed dpe/nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /zab mi rtog pa rtogs dka' bas/cing zhi ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /'di ni byang chub rim brtan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ral gri'i dam tshig gis de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /sgyu ma ji ltar me long ltar/ /nang gi gzugs/nam rang bzhin med pa'i dpe/mkha' ji ltar bde ji ltar/ /ji ltar dngos po rang bzhin med par/yongs shes pa/ /'di ni byang chub lam/rim brtan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma bdag med mas de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /mtshams kyi lha mo rnams kyis/ stong rtog pa las/nyid rtog pa'i/dri ma/med dam pa'i gnas/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nyid| |ji rtog pa/ srid ma zhig bar du ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bsgom mi rtog par|par gyis/ /mā ma kī yi'o/ /srid med mya ngan de 'khor bar zhen pa'ang med la/'das las|par zhen pa'ang*/med/ /'di de bde chen rdo rje ste/ /gang zhig yid kyi sgom pas bsgom| |par bya ba min/de ni mchog gi sgom pas phyag rgya chen po/bsgom/ /spyan gyi'o// sngags a hūm̐ sogs/ dang yi ge rnam par spangs/ /de mtshan bcas kyi/ni sems med thig zla tshes/ ler zhen pa'ang*/med/ /'di de dam pa'i bde chen te/ /bri mi mthun pa'i/ ba med cing gang ba med/ /gnyen po/gos dkar mo yi'o/ /gzugs brnyan rang bzhin ji med pa/ lta bar/ /de ltar dngos po bsgom par bya/ /stong nyid dri med mchog gi gnas/ /der ni bsod nams dang*/sdig par zhen pa'i rtog pa/ pa med/ / sgrol ma'i'o/ /ji dper na/ltar chu nang zla ba ste/ /bden med pas/min brdzun snang bas|pa min pa ltar/

/de ltar dkyil 'khor du snang ba/'khor lo 'di/ /lus snang yang rang bzhin med pa/ kyi rang bzhin rnyog pa med/ /'khor thams cad kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal to/ /de nas sa'i cho ga dang 'brel ba/bcom ldan 'das mtshon cha 'phen pa la sogs pa las/ sna tshogs byed pa lha'i bu'i bdud las/ rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ mda' gzhu'i char 'di nyid kyis sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /mda' ltong phyed pa la/mu mtheb mdzub seng ge'i rna ba dang*| ts+tshu ṭi dang ser rna ltong gnyis pa/yis/ /chang gzhu'i/gzung khu tshuraskam khas mda' bzung ste/ khu tshur gyis/bzung ba yis/ /gzhu ni 'dod pa'i g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis rgyud ltong sbyar nas 'dzin pa/khu tshur gyis/ /bsdams pas dgra lha'i bu'i bdud las/rnams bsdigs paramadzub bya/ /gzung lugs sam dgang lugs/yan lag kos kor dpung mgor kos ko rab bzung ste/bzung nas zer thad kar drang ba/ni/ /mtshon 'ben la gtod/ cha khu tshur khu tshur 'ben la gtad byas te/bzung nas ni/ /kha'i hūm̐ gis mda' ni btang bya zhing*/ / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor bsdigs par bya/ /g.yon brkyang sogs bya gsung*/brla gru mo/ni pus mo/ bskum par byas nas ni/ /lus gzhu ni/ dbugs rngub kyis srang zhing zer/ ni dbugs kyis dgang bar bya/ /rna ltag g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis rgyud ltong sbyar nas 'dzin pa/ khu g.yas par/tshur bzung nas ni/ /brang ni rgyas pa nyid du bya/ /sems dang mig ni 'ben la blta bar/bya/ /hūm̐ gis kha ni dgang ba dang*/ /g.yas brkyang la sogs sbyor ba yis/ /gshin rje srin po mdas/gsad par bya/ /'dir mang brjod pas ci zhig bya/ /kun rdzob tu ni mda' gzhu'i rig byed/bsdus pa tsam/ /gzhu yi rig byed rtse ba gang*/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin spyod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rol mo'i sgra zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

rol mo'i sgra'i sgeg mdzes pa|pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /tha hi tha hi/ tha ka tha ka tha tha tha tha/ tha ho tha ho/ ba hiṃ ba hiṃ/ bhi hi bhi hi zer/u ḍhaṃ u ḍhaṃ/ kraṃ ka kraṃ ka tha ka tha ka hi hi /ta ṭa wa ha ḍa wa tā/ ma tsa pi te bsil chung zhes bya ba ting ting shag gam 'khar rnga la 'gro/cha sgra de rnams/ lang ḍi ṇa ḍi ma zhes bya ba rnga rings/dbyug pa gcig gis brdung*|dang ni rnga dang yang*/ /rdza phyogs gcig g.yogs pa/rnga kha cig rgu po rgyud mangs/pi wang rgyas| |pin dza ra ste rnga kha gcig pa zhig yod/mngar ma dhu ra ste ḍā ma ru yin/ba can dang gling bu dang*| |rgyud ba la na ri ste pi wang rgyud gsum pa/gsum a la pa zer/ka ra ṭa ka ni/ / rnga'i rigs yin zer mi shes/rnam pa che 'bring*/gsum brdung bas brdung bar bya/ /chung ngur 'dul ba la sogs pa/brdungs pas brgyal ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir slob dpon la/ gsol gdab la sogs pa/ /rol mo'i/mchod pa 'di ni bla na med/ /rang gi tshigs bcad mang por ni/ /bstan pa 'dis ni ci zhig bya/ /ji snyed rol mo'i bstan bcos su/ /bstan/de ni rdo rje'i rol rigs la dbul ba'i/mo'i sgra/ /'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das dri bzang po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bdug spos kyi mchod pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /tsan+dan nyid dang gnyis zer/gur gum dang*/ /brag zhun de bzhin 'dod ma dbang po lag pa/ni/ /'di rnams rdzas ni bdug spos che/ /he ru ka la mi bskyod pa/rab tu dbul/ /ka tso sna rtog tu dkar po ga bur gyi dri bro bar dang rkun ma dang*/ / spang spos/de bzhin du yang skra sgra ke sha shap+ta/nyid/ /ba sha ka'am pa li ka dri zhim shos so//'du byed snying po 'di rnams ni/ /phan pa la ni sbyar bar bya/ /lce pog kun spos dkar nag po|

tu ru dang bo la thang chu/ka /ghan dhar sa snag tsha la 'jugari gla ba/dwags lte ba sen dung gi kha chod mo chu srin sen/ni/ /rin chen rgyal po'i bdug pa 'di/ /spos de dag kun la mi bu ram a ru ra kun la zer/'jig a ru ra/gu ram dang*/ /sha tsam shags yob/thī tri yi sha thī de'i khyad par bzang po/dang*/ /ka ko la/sha brag zhun/li dza sre mong bas che/dang shi la ka /du ru ka 'jig rten mgon gyi bdug pad dkar/pa 'di/ /rtag tu rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs| |sna tshogs dri ni khyad par du/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i mchod pa hūm̐ las bskyed pa dbul/las/ /bdun gyi rgyal po'i mchod pa 'di/ /kun dus/ tu gsod pa/ stobs kyis bsgrub pa ste/ /ji snyed dri yi bstan bcos su/ /gong ri lu zer/ bu'i dum phye ma zer|bu'i bdug pa mchog /de kun phyag na rdo rje yi/ /rdo rje'i mchod par rab tu grags| |de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo sa gzung ba'i dus su/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i gom pa rnam par dgod pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te| rdo rje gar 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /gus lha'i rnal 'byor| bcas dang por sgeg par ldan/ /dang por 'gying ba/rtsed zur migabacas rjes lha'i rnal 'byor/rgyu bas/ /rtsa ba'i rkang stabs bzhi po rang la thabs dang shes rab gyi bye brag gis gsung*| rkang g.yas brkyang*/stabs g.yon brkyang*/dkyil zlum skor/ mi mnyam/ mnyam pa/ rus sbal/ phyed krung*/ rdo rje'i go cha stabs te gom stabs so//brgyad du cho ga yis/ /rdo rje gom pas rol ba bya/ /me lag pa'i phyag rgya/tog snyim pa sbyor ba dang*/ /spos kyi yal ga'i sbyong ba dang*| |mar me'i sdong po'i lag tshul dang*/ /yang ni byug pa'i lugs dang ni/ / mig mig dang brla'i thad drang dang nang du sor mo drangs te mthe'u chung kyog pa'o//lag de phyed krung*/

bzhin brla nang dang*/ /rkang pa gnyis kyi mthe bong nas bzung zhing rdo rje'i gar sbyor ba/rkang pa'i 'og tu bskor g.yas brkyangs nas/ba ni/ /btung ba'i ting ting shag lta bu/ sbyor bas rol pa bya/ /de bzhin du yang g.yon pas brkyang bas kyang bskor/ so/ /de nas lus smad de mdom bgrad nas rkang pa'i rtse mos 'gro ba'o/ /rgyun gyi gar byas nas/ /g.yon pas ni rkang pa bsnol te de bskyod pa'o/ /kyang ni gar bya zhing*/ /myur du brdungs pas ni lag pa brdab pa'o//de bzhin rkang pa bsnol ba zur gnyis phan tshun yang yang bzlog pas so//gar/ /byas nas 'khor lo lta bur bskor/ /ba ni rkang pa g.yon pa sa la btsugs te g.yas pa bteg nas skor ba'o//phyi nas gru bzhir dgang bar bya/ /phyi nas 'dod pa'i lag pas pad kor/ bskor| |sa la pus mo/ ni gnyis btsugs nas/ /lag pas mchod rten gyi tshul du spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/legs par bya/ /ji snyed gar gyi bstan bcos su/ /byed pa'i cha lugs brjod pa ni/ /de snyed rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /sgeg pas byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor mnyes par bya ba las mi 'da' bas/ dam tshig rdo rje mnyes par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dus nang gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga'adi nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar dmigs nas/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyiphyag rgya lnga/sa rnam par brgyan/ /thams dngos su/ cad 'byor 'dod yon lnga/pa'am dmigs ma 'byor na yid kyis/nas ni/ /bems ro/po'i gnas lto ba zer/su sreg nang gi blugs bya/ /dngos su gtso bo/shar yul gang la 'bum na/lho byang dang ga phyogs nub/su/ /phyogs gnas rnams ni mchod pa/dga' bar bya/ / phyogs bral gnas mtshams/ su lha puk+ka sī la sogs pa/mo rnams/ /dam pa'i yar mar gyi dus bzang po la/tshe yis dūr bas/

mchod par phyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bya/ /phyi yid dngos su ma 'byor na/kyis mar khu bsams pa dang*/ /'bras so ba dang*/chag pa/med pa'i/'bras dang ni/ /'bru dang zho yi zan dang ni/ /til dang de bzhin mnyam pa'i yam shing*/ shing*| |dūr ba rab tu gzhon pa nyid/ /lha'i bsam nang gi sbyin sreg gi dus su de thams cad bsams la/gtan rdo rje sbyin sreg bya/ /de la phyi nang gnyis kyi sngags/'di ni sngags kyi rkang pa yin te/ oṃ ag ne ye swāhā/mar gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba thams cad/pā paṃ sdig pa/ da ha na badz+ra ya 'joms pa rdo rje/badz+ra sa twa s+ya rdo rje sems dpa'i/sarba thams cad/pā paṃ sdig pa/ da ha 'joms pa/swāhā/ til nag po'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ta rdo rje me tog ye swāhā/ 'bras ma chag pa'i'o/ /oṃ sarba thams cad/saṃ zas/pa de swāhā/ zho dang zan dam pa'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra rdo rje/bi dzā rnam par rgyal ba/ya swāhā/ 'bras so ba'i'o/ /oṃ ma chen po/hā be nas/ga ya swāhā/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba lā ya stobs po che/swāhā/ mon sran gre'u yi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra rdo rje za phod/ghasma rī swāhā/ gro yi'o/ /oṃ rdo rje/ badz+ra ā yu ṣe tshe/swāhā/ dūr ba gzhon nu'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya thogs pa med pa'i rdo rje/swāhā/ ku sha'i'o// oṃ badz+ra/ rdo rje/bi dzā rgyal ba/swāhā/ u dum wa ra yi'o/ /oṃ bo byang chub shing*/dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swāhā/ byang chub kyi shing gi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra la 'khril shing*/tā ya swāhā/ pa la k+ṣa yi'o// oṃ badz+ra ku be rā rdo rje gnod sbyin/ya swā hā/ n+ya gro dha yi'o/ /oṃ ha sa ha sa ka rā ya swā hā| a mra yi'o/ /me tog gi bsreg rdzas/tsam pa/ka dkar po/a sho kā shing las skyes pa'i me tog yang klu/ /ka dam pa dang srid sgrub nyid/ /ardzu na'i me togaji ltar rnyed pa bzlas byas sa/ /me tog 'dis nisbyin sreg bya/ /rgun 'bras bu'i bsreg rdzas/'brum a mra sbrul 'jig shing tog chen po/dang*/

kha 'dzag tshur bya ba 'bras bu dmar po skye ba zhig yod/skyes ma rtse ma na ri ka li ra'i 'bras bu/ni/ /'khor rigs lnga'i/lo lnga yi chog rim pas/ / 'bras bu rnams kyi sbyin sreg bya/ /gzhan yang*/sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi nyid/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yi bsgom pa yis/ /'dis ni rdo rje mnyes par 'gyur/ /ye shes me ni rab dgyes bya/ /rgyal de gang na/ba phan pa mnyes pa dang*/ /gser gyi mnga' bdag mnyes pa dang*/ /pad+ma gar dbang mnyes pa dang*/ /lcags mchog bdag po mnyes pa dang*/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi/tshangs pa brgya byin dbang phyugachen po dang*/ khyab 'jug rlung dang me chen dang*/ /thong gshol mda' 'dzin/ldan nyid dang 'dod lha sdig can/dang*/ /zla ba nyi ma gdon gzhan gra ha na gza' 'am gdon las dang res gza'/ dang*| |sa'i lha/ni zhags pa chu lha/'dzin pa dang*/ /lus ngan byang ni gnod sbyin/de bzhin mtshams skyong dang*/ /srin po/chos gshin rje/rgyal dang ni klu dang ni/ /dri za lha min mi'am ci/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa'i lha/ /'og min du ni gnas pa dang*| |gang zhig rgyal chen bzhi/gnas pa dang*/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang sgyur nyid dang ni/ /'phrul dga' yi ni lha rnams dang*/ /gang zhig dag pa'i gnas son dang*| |gtsang ma'i lha lnga/'od zer 'jig rten khams gnas dang*/ /mi mjed khams su gnas gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya/pa dang*/ /gling bzhir gnas pa'i sems can dang*/ /gang zhig khams gsum gnas pa 'dod/gzugs/gzugs med/dang*/ / snod ldan sems can bcud thams cad/'jig rten dang*/ /lcug ma'i tshogs dang rtswa sogs la brten pa'i sems can la/dang*/ /gang sa bcu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mnyes par ston|zhig rab dga'i sar dang po/gnas dang*/ /pha rol gnyis pa/dri med gang phyin dang*| |'od bzhi pa/'phro can du gnas pa dang*/ /mi g.yo'i brgyad pa/gnas su byas pa dang*/ /dgu pa shugs la/gang zhig chos sprin bcu pa/

rjes song dang*/ /gang zhig sbyang lnga pa/dkar son pa dang*/ /drug pa shugs la/gang zhig ring song bdun pa/thob pa dang*||'od gsum pa/byed du ni gnas pa ste/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po dang*// 'phags rgyun zhugs rgyu 'bras la sogs pa/pa'i gang zag brgyad po dang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos nyid/ /rā ni ral bse ru zer/gri'i gzugs rang rgyal/ can dang*| |dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams ni/ /sbyin sreg phyi nang gicho gnyis kyi/gas dgyes pa nyid/ /de bzhin du/nyid tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /gyis mnyes par byed/bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po rgya mtsho rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya chen po sgrub pa'i dus su yum dang*/rjes su chags pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ dam phyag rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pa de bsten pa'i dam tshig tshig la gsol ba gdab pa 'di gsungs so/ /rdo thabs shes rab lhag pa'i lhar bskyed pa gsung*/rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis med/bskyed pa ni/ /rdo hūm̐/ rje pad+ma'i a/ bsgom pa ste/ /de rdo rje/yi mgo bo'i sna rtse la/ /phyag oṃ dgod/'tshal yid bo la'i rtser/bzhin nor bu ste/ /sbu gu'i nang du phaṭa ser pos byang sems bkag pa/ kyis ni/ /ye shes kyi rten thig le/kyi ltung yang dag gnas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dgyes par mdzod/ /zag med kyi bde ba mngon du byed par/'dis ni phyag rgyabasten pa'i cho ga las/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /rdo de ka rje sems dpa' rang mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor yin/snyems byas

( 1 ) nas/ / ( 3 ) gnas ni thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang*/bsgrub par bya/ / ( 2 ) phyag rgya chen mā ma kī/po'i gnas 'dug nas/ / ( 4 ) rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bdag /shākya seng ge rnam snang*/ bsnyems byas nas ( ka ) / / ( ga ) rgyal mā ma kir bskyed pa dang snyoms par zhugs pa las/po thams cad mi bskyod pa'i dngos grub/ 'thob par 'gyur/ / ( kha ) las kyi phyag spyan ma'i/rgya'i gnas 'dug nas/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bdag /rang*/rdo rje gzi brjid rin 'byung*/ ting 'dzin ldan/ /dam tshig rin chen sgrol mar bskyed/phyag rgya sbyor ba yis/ /gnas rin po che'i gsung*/gsum po yang bsgrub par bya/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas// pad+ma gar 'od dpag med pa/gyi dbang phyug bdag /chos gos dkar mor bskyed/ kyi phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin dngos grub/gnas/ /rdo rje'i chos ni bsgom par bya/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /rta dngos grub/mchog gi rnal 'byor ba/rim par gnas nas ni/ / dam tshig sgrol ma/phyag rgyas sbyor ba yis/ /sgrol ma'i dngos bskyed pa dang snyoms par zhugs pas rta mchog gi grub rab bsgrub bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gar dang*/ 'dod pa bde ba skyed par/byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 'gyur la la las 'byung*/ snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje'i gar mdzad pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /g.yon brkyang ba dang*/ g.yas g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu dkur brten*/brkyang ba dang*/ mnyam pa'i rkang pa gshibs la/ stabs dang*/ rdo rje'i rkang g.yas kyi rting pa g.yon gyi mthil du btsugs te brkyang ba/stabs dang*/ dkyil zlum po zer/ 'khor rkang pa bgrad nas lag pa gdengs pa'i sor mo'i rtse mo nang du/ dang*/ sna sa ga tshogs zer/ thams cad zer yang mi mnyam pa'i rkang stabs yin gsung*/dang*/ rus sbal gyi rkang tsog pur 'dug nas g.yon pa'i bol gong g.yas kyis mnan te/stabs dang*/

bung ba'i 'phur stabs skyil krung phyed pa byas nas rdo dril thogs nas g.yas skor byed pa/ba'i drwa ba dang*/ rgya rkang pa bteg ste bskor zhing bskor zhing g.yab pa/mtsho'i rba rlabs/bskyod pa dang*/ ri bo'i mchog 'debs pa'i thabs/ dang*| mdzes pa'i gom ni dang po g.yas de nas rting pa brla'i nang du btsugs nas yang de bzhin du bya|pa dang*/ khro bo'i gom stabs/pa ste/ rkang stabs kyis dgod pa'o/ /bcu gnyis/ ral pad kor sngon du song bas rdo rje snying khar dril bu dkur gzung*/gri'i lugs 'phyar ba lta bu'i tshul dang zer dbus/dang*/sdigs pa zhes bcu drug po kun la snang*/ 'khor lag pa/lo'i shar/tshul du skor/dang*/ rin rtse gsum pa/po che'i lho/tshul du lag pa byed pa/dang*/ pad bskor ba/ma'i lag nub/ pa dang*/ ral byang*/ gri'i shubs nas 'byin pa'i/tshul dang*/ mdung dbus kyi/gi tshul du rtse mo gnyis 'byed pa'i/dang*/ 'phen pa zer/ gzhu'i mda' 'phen pa'i/tshul dang*/shar gsum| dbyig 'phyar ba/pa'i tshul dang*/ dbyig to'i tshul dang*/ gtun lhor gsum/ shing gi tshul dang*/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i de bsdams pa'i gung mo gnyis rtser byas/tshul dang kha bcu pa'i sor mo bcu char bskyod pa'i tshul/ tshul dang*/ ral nub gsum/gri'i bu mo'i chu gri zer|tshul phyogs/dang*/ /sna ngo mtshar gyi dbyug pa zer/tshogs su bsnun pa'i tshul du byed pa dbyig pa'i tshul dang*/ mdung thung gi tshul dang*/ gong 'di dag ni sdigs byed bcu drug go/ /bu byang gsum/skyong ba'i dbyig tho zer/tshul dang*/ sgro can/'phan ba dan/gnyis pa tshul zer sor gnyis ston pa/dang*/ 'phan ba dan/lce sor mo gsum ston pa'i tshul zer kun la/gsum pa tshul zer| dang*/ me byang shar/tog gi 'thor ba'i/ tshul dang*/ bdug spos thur la rdung tshul/kyi tshul dang*/ mar me'i tshul dang*/ dri byug pa'i tshul tshul drug zer/ dang*/ lā s+ye'i byang shar|lag pa dang*/

phreng ba'i lag pa dang*/ glu'i lag pa dang*/ gar gyi lag pa dang*| gling byang shar/bu'i lag lag pa gling bu 'bud pa'i tshul zer/ lag pa pi wang sbreng ba'i tshul dang zer des 'gre/ pa dang*/ pi wang gi lag pa dang*/ rdza rnga'i lag pa dang*/ mu kun da'i lag pa ste/ lag pa'i brgyad zer/ dgod pa'o/ /rdo rje skyil krung rting pa gnyis g.yas g.yon gyi brla steng du thal byung ba/ dang*/ pad+ma'i skyil krung bcas nas rkang mthil gnyis nang du bcug pa/ dang*/ pad rkang pa gnyis brkyang pa'i mthe bong gnyis pad+ma ltar bya/ ma'i 'dug stangs dang*/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs rkang pa bag tsam bsnol la pus mo cung zad bteg dang*| skyil krung phyed pa g.yas pa'i sor mo g.yon pa'i sgyid par bcug pa/dang*/ bkra shis kyi 'dug lag pa bram ze rig byed 'dod pa ltar byas nas rkang pa tsog pur 'dugastangs te/ 'dug stangs kyi dgod pa'o/ /drugasgeg sku'i nyams gsum zer/ pa'i ro nyams zer/dang*/ dpa' bo'i ro dang*/ mi sdug pa'i ro dang*/ rgod pa'i gsung gi nyams gsum/ ro dang*/ drag po'i ro dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba'i ro dang*/ zhi ba'i thugs kyi nyams gsum/ro dang*| ngam pa'i ro dang*/ snying rje'i ro'o/ /drug gi rjes ṣa yis mgo drangs te len pa/ su skyes pa'i ṣa ḍa pa a nu ghi ta/glu dang*/ drang srong ṛ yis mgo drang te ri sha a nu ghi ta/gi rjes kyi glu dang*/ dri za'i gha yis mgo drangs pa/ rjes kyi glu dang*/ gan+dhar+pa a nu ghi ta/ bar ma'i rjes kyi glu dang*/ ma yis mgo 'dren ma dh+ya na a nu ghi ta/ lnga pa rjes pa yis mgo 'dren/ kyi glu pañtsa a nu ghi ta dang*/ blo gsal gyi rjes be yis mgo 'dren/kyi bā+e ba ta a nu ghi ta/'khor nis mgo 'dren pa/nyan pa'i ni sha ta a nu ghi ta/glu'o/ /nyung mjug tu dal ba zer/ ngu'i nyung ngur len pa| dbye ba dang*/ dal ba/sgrol de bas che bar len pa/ba'i myur du/dbye ba dang*/

'jigs drag par len pa/ pa'i drag pa'i/ dbye ba dang*/ kha gang rdzogs pa/ba dang*/ phyed bkang phyed/ phyi ba dang*/ rnam 'gyur gnyis 'dren pa/par 'dre ring bo dang phyed bcag gnyis 'dres nas len/ ba de rnams 'dres pa zer/dang*/ mgo 'dren gnyis/'dod chags gnyis ka na bya ba dang la brjod nas hūm̐ phyi nas brjod pa lta bu'o//mtshungs par byed pa dang*/ 'dod chags gsum dang po yi ge gsum brjod nas phyis gcig brjod pa lta bu'o//mtshungs par byed pa dang*/ lkog ma gre phugs 'ba' zhig tsam bsdams te len pa/nyed pa dang*/ rkan nyed u u/pa rkan 'ba' zhig brdabs te mnan pa/dang*/ lce nyed pa da da dang*/ so si si di di/nyed pa ste/ glu'i dgod pa'o| |sa gzhi yongs gzung dus su ni/ /dam tshig 'di ni rab bskul ba/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyis bya/ /'di ni dam tshig rim pa'i mchog /me tog 'di rnams dngos po/bzang zhing dge /sdig pa med pas/dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag ni dad pas bsam pas/ 'bum lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod| |tshal dag ro yi nags tshal bcud ni yid du 'ong zer/phan pa dang*/ gang zhig dri dang bdug sbos mchog /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnams sel ba/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥdril bu blang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐| rdo rje gzung ba'i sngags so/ /dngos po sna tshogs rnam par phye ba'i le'u ste bcu sho lo ka gnyis brgya tham pa'o//bzhi pa'o// //de nas he ru ka bzhi sgom par ma zad gsum yang bsgom par bstan/rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ / rnal 'byor ma yi rdo rje gur/

/sangs 'khor du gtogs pa'i/ rgyas kun dang sangs rgyas la/ /tshig ni 'di dag bka' stsal pa/ /phyag sngon du 'gro ba tshogs gnyis bsags pa sngar dang 'dra/ gzhal yas khang bskyed/ dpa' bo gcig pa yin na med/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom na bskyed par bya/ lha bskyed lugs mngon byang lnga las bskyed/gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ / rdo rje cho ga gsum/las skyes rang bzhin can/ /lag par rdo rje thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin zer/rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bsams snying kha nas lha mo/nas spro zhing trai lo kya zhes pa/bzlas pa'o/ /phyag bzhi pa ni nyid dang yang*/ /zhal gsum rdo rje cho ga gsum/las byung ba/ /dkar g.yas|po dmar g.yon/po de bzhin sngo/ /phag mo lhan cig mnyam sbyor ba'o/ /phyag spyan| drug pa la kha dog gnag /lcags yum/sgrog ma dang lhan cig sbyor/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi thod pa can/ /zhal gsum nyid du sbyor bar bya/ /snying khar nyi ma la hrīḥbasams nas mchod pa nas chos 'byung gi bar du kha bskang*/ der dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su hrīḥlas pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su mngon byang lnga las stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can skra ser po gyen la brdzes pa|phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba'i do shal can spyan gsum pa zhal gcig ma phyag bzhi na g.yas g.yon dang por ut+pal zum pa'i mda' dang*/ me tog rgyas pa'i gzhu/ gzhan gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang ut+pala'i zhags pa kha dog dmar ser la phyed krung du bzhugs par bsam/sa mā ya dzaḥs ye shes pa gzhugadabang bskur/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis spyi bor mtshan mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang bzlas/mdog sgrol ma/dmar phyag ni bzhi pa dang*/ /zhal gcig ma dang dbang byed ma/ /rdo rje chos kyis spyi bo'i/gnas mnan ma/ /'di ni ku ru kul+ler gnas pas sgrol mar/brjod// 'di yi sngags gong rtsa ba'i rgyud du/ni brjod pa'o/ /thabs shes gnyis ka'i rgyud yin pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi ston/

btsun 'di dag bdag gis thos pa ste/ /dus gcig dus ni gcig na'o| |bdag gis bcom ldan spyan sngar te/ /btsun mo'i chos su rnam rgyas pas/ /zer/mo'i chos la gnas pa ni/ khyod kyi spyan sngar bdag gis ni/ /dus gcig pa yi dus su ni// bdag nyid kyis ni 'di thos nas/ /rgyas pa nyid du rab tu dbye/ /chos/lta stangs dgug dang brda chen dang*/ /don byed nus dang char sogs so/ /laṃ lo ke shwa ra/gyi sngon 'gro kha bskang*/ rdo rje cho ga yan lag gsum las bskyed/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/de nyid las skyes pa/ /thub pa chen po 'jig rten mgon/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa// mchod g.yas/ sbyin dang ni pad+mas g.yon/ brgyan/ /pad+ma'i gdan la yang dag gnas| |dbu rgyan rdo rje chos dang ldan/ /mañdzu shrī maṃ 'jam dpal/gyi de nyid las 'di thams cad gong mas 'gre/skyes pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni ser po ste/ /yan lag mchog g.yas/sbyin g.yon/ut+pal rin po ches/brgyan/ /mi bskyod rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin// hūm̐ ya man+ta ka gi ye shes las byung ba/ /lag par g.yas/ral gri g.yon/sdigs mdzub nyid| |ma he chen po'i rgyab tu ni/ /dpa' bo g.yon zhabs/brkyang pa yis gnas/ khro bo'i gzugs can 'jigs byed de/ kha yum dang*/sbyar mdun cod pan zer/du mi spyi bor| bskyod 'dzin/ /hūm̐ gi ye shes las byung ba/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje can/ /rdo phyag na/rje dril bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /lag pa gnyis kyis phyag rgyab sprad nas mdzub mo dang mthe chung bsnol ba/rgya 'ching*/ /rkang pa g.yon nyid brkyang ba yis/ /'jigs mu stegs kyi lha/byed mnan pa yi ni lus/ /spyi bor rdo rje rigs mi bskyod pa/bsams nas/ / 'jig rten gsum rgyal dran par bya/ /twāṃ tā ra/gi yi ge las byung ba/ /mchog g.yas|sbyin g.yon/ dbang mchog mtshon cha ut+pal ral gris mtshan pa/ste/ /lha mo ljang khu sna tshogs/lta bu ste/

/rtag tu bzang po'i 'dug g.yon bskum g.yas cung zad brkyang ba/stangs gnas| |sna tshogs pad+mar yang dag gnas/ /spyi bor don yod 'dzin pa mo/ / sgeg mo chen po skal bzang ma/ /sgrol ma'i gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /maṃ 'od zer can/gyi yi ma ri ts+ya/ge las byung ba/ /mchog g.yas/sbyin a g.yon/ sho ka mya ngan med pa'i shing*/'dzin ma/ /nyi ma shar ba lta bu ste/ /rnam snang dpal ni spyi bor skyes/ / g.yon brkyang pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /'gro mgyogs rta mdun gyis drangs pa'i/bdun gyi shing rta nyi ma/mnan/ /spyi bor*/yan lag nyams dgu las/ sgeg pa'i ro yis rnam snang*/ brgyan| |'od zer can ni bsgom par bya/ /tsuṃ tsun+da/gyi yi ge las byung ba/ /ston ka'i nam mkha' zer/zla ba lta bu'i 'od/ /snying khar rin chen snyim par gnas/ / mdzes pa'i tshul gyis yang dag bzhugs/ /lha mo sna tshogs pad gdan can/ / phan pas mgo bo mnan pa ste/ /byang chos 'byung las/chub sems ni 'dzag 'bab pa'i| |lha mo stobs bde bas myos pa'i lus zer/ dang bral ba lha mo bde bas myos par bsgom zer|bsgom/ /nor rgyun ma/ baṃ ba su dha ra/gyi yi ge las byung ba/ /nor 'dzin shin tu kha dog ser*/ /lag pa mchog sbyin 'bras kyi/snye ma/ /rdo rje skyil krung sbyor ba las// yan spyi bor/lag rin chen 'byung gnas brgyan/ /spyan ni shin tu sgeg par ni/ / gnod sbyin rgyal mo bsgom par bya/ /nor gyi bdag po mtshungs par 'gyur/ dzaṃ dzaṃ bha la/gi yi ge las byung ba/ /nam mkha' dzaṃ bha la/mdzod ces bya ba bsgom/ kha dog ser zhing g.yas pa na/ /mchog g.yas/sbyin gyi phyag rgyas shing tog bi dza pu ra g.yon/rin chen ne'u le/ /rin chen 'byung gnas rdo rje yis/ /spyi bo'i dkyil 'khor rnam par brgyan/ /rin chen char ni bsam par bya/ /skyor mor rdo rje'i chu blugs dbul ba zer/ gang rdo rje chur gzhug bya/ /dbyangs can ma/

praṃ so sor 'brang ma/gi pra ti sa re/yi ge las skyes pa/ /lus ni dkar zhing yid 'ong ma/ /lha mo ral gri 'khor lo 'dzin/ spyi bor phan pas mnan pa'o ( ka ) / / ( ga ) rang las rab 'thon dus bzhin du/ gis bu btsa' ba/ mang po'i dus lta bur/ /bsgom par/ ( kha ) dkyil 'khor dbus su zlum po'i bzhugs tshul/ yang dag zlum po'i 'dug stangs te rkang pa'i sor mo nang du bstan nas mtho gsum du bgrad pa'o// gnas| |zer/ ( nga ) nam bsam pa/mkha'i bha ga nas/gnas nas ngo bo/'jam pa'i dbyangs| |rnam pa bu khye'u/'byung bar rnam par bsam par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sngags sna tshogs nang du chud pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sngags kyi tshogs 'di gsal bar mdzad pa| rang gi snying kha'i sa bon la skor ba'am kha nas lte bar 'khor ba'am/ lha'i sku la dmigs te bzlas pa gang rung bya/oṃ rin po che dang 'dra ba'i so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rtog dang bral/ ma nor bu/ṇ-i pad+me pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos pa dang 'dra/hūm̐ phaṭa kyis stong pa'i yid/swāhā/ oṃ ming*/mañdzu 'jam dpal rdo rje|badz+rā ya sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yid kyi mchogamuḥswāhā/ oṃ bdud thams cad gan rkyal du bsgyel ba hrīḥṣ+ti wi mche ba gtsigs pa sdang ba 'dul ba/kṛ tā zhal rnam par 'gyur ba 'jigs su rung ba|na na hūm̐ hūm̐ rga ba dang 'chi ba sel ba gsum/phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sgrol ma/hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sgrol ma/ tā re myur du sgrol matut+tā re tu re sgrol mdzad/swāhā/ oṃ bdud mā ri gnod pa ts+yā+ai swāhā/ oṃ tsa bskyod ma/le tsu bskul ma/ le tsun skul byed/de swāhā/ /oṃ nor rgyun/ ba su dha re mahā chen po/ba su bṛṣ+ṭhi ba su dha re mahā bar 'di'i yi ge bcu gnyis rgya dpe kun la mi snang*/ba su bṛṣ+ṭhi nor 'dzin/ ni pa ta nor chen/ni ba zhabs can/su swāhā/

oṃ rmugs 'dzin/dzaṃ bha la dza chu/len tra dbang*/ye swāhā/ oṃ ma nor bu 'dzin/ṇi dha skyes pa dang bud med rin po che mngal du 'dzin pa/ri badz+ri rdo rje/ṇi mahā pra ti sa re so sor 'brang ma chen mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ /'jig lha de rnams las gang dang gang la shis pa bstan/rten mgon gyis nad rnams zhi/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis blo gros ngan/ /pa sel/gshin rje gshed kyis yi dwags srung*/ /lha dang lha min hūm̐ mdzad kyis/ /srung zhing*/sgrol mas 'jig rten dbang du byed/ /'od zer can gyis chom rkun 'jig /tsun+das sems can thams cad ni/ /dgug pa yi ni cho gar brjod/ /dzaṃ bha la dang nor sbyin dang*/ /nor gyi bsgrub pa'i thabs su brjod| |bud med gang zhig bu shi bas/ /so sor 'brang ma rtag dran bya/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa yi/ /sngags kyi rkyang pas thams cad 'grub/ /gong du bsnyen pa/bzlas lha bsgom pa dang*/pa 'bum gyi sbyor ba yis/ /las zhi ba la sogs pa'i/ rnams thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /snying pos/gi bde ba lha la*/bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //de nas sngon 'gro dang bsrung 'khor dang chos kyi 'byung gnas dang rdo rje bzhi las sngar bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge las skyes pa/ /phyag gnyis pa dang zhal gcig ldan/ kha dog gnag cing cher 'bar ba/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa po| |mgo bo'i phreng bas khrag 'dzag do shal byas/ /mche ba chen pos 'jigs par byed/ /gzugs thung gzi brjid chen po nyid/ kha nas khrag ni 'dzag pa ste// bzlas pa'i sngags oṃ mahā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/slob dpon la rtag gang sdang dang*/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum khro dang*/ /sems can du ma gsod byed pa/ /nag po chen pos za bar byed/ /rang gi lag g.yas kyi gri yis/sha gcod byed/

khrag thod par/gi rgyun ni 'thung bar byed/ /de nas spyi bor 'di 'dug nas/ /de ni til tsam du song ba la gri gug gis/gcod par byed/ /mon sran ma'i bye bragasran gre'u dang 'dzam 'bras dang bsres pa la bya/ bu ti/ /me tog bdug pa byug pa chang*/ /sha lnga nyid dang bdud rtsi yis| |nag po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /sngags ni/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ sha sa nā bstan pa la gnod par byed pa/ pa ha ka ri ne/ 'di phyis kyi dus su/e ṣā a pash+tsi nag po chen po/ mahā ka lā+o ya khyod kyis 'di/ m+mi daṃ rat+na dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed pa 'di sngon gyi dam bcas pa dran par mdzod cig tra yā pa ka ri ṇaṃ ya di pra ti dzñaṃ sma ra si ta dā i 'di/daṃ duṣ+taṃ gdug pa/ kha kha zo zo/khā hi khā hi nges par zo gnyis/mā ra mā ra sod gnyis/ gri h+na gri h+na rims la sogs pas zung gnyis/bhan+dha bhan+dha chings gnyis/ ha na 'bar ba rnon po/ ha na da ha da ha sregs gnyis/pa tsa pa tsa tshos gnyis/di na nyin zhag cig ma bzhag/me ke na phaṭa hūm̐/ tsha ba pi pi ling na le shaṃ lga/gsum gyis gzugs brnyan ni/ /byas nas lus la tsher mas dgang*| |dug dang ske sogs kyis ming snying khar/bris nas/ /de ni gang gi ming gis ni/ /de nas me la gdung bar bya/ /de yi dus na mi snang 'chi bar/'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub sgom thob par bya ba'i phyir de thob pa'i thabs/pa nyid/ /phyag rgya'i la brten pa'i/dngos grub dngos grub gyi de nyid bstan/ dngos grub che/ /dngos grub gnyis po/kun gyi spyod yul min/ /de dus phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i/ de yi lus thob cing*/ /skad cig na ni bde chen tshul/ /skad cig na ni sa bcu la sogs pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i/de 'khor ldan/ /sgom rgyu bskyed rdzogs/ pa dang ni sngags bzlas pa/nyid dang*/ /skad cig de ltar goms par byas nas phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i la gar/sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/

/du bsams nas/spyan phyag rgya der bskyed nas/ gyis phrag nas 'khyud pa'o/ /skad cig la ni zhal sbyor/ gnyis med ldan/ /dga' zag pa med pa'i/ba chen po mchog tu dga'/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal skad cig gis/ /mā ma kī sbyor bas/dang bde ba chen po bskyed pas/sdom/ /rtog pa/rdo rje gnyis ye shes bde ba chen pos|pad+ma'i rtsa mchod pas/ /skad gcig byang sems brgyad dam bcu drug mngon du byas pa/ gis ni gnyis med ye shes bde ba chen po dang*/ldan/ /zhal sbyor/rdo rje skad cig gis 'od dpag med du bskyed nas pad+ma rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/gus pa'i pha rol rtog pa las/ son/ /rdo rje pad+ma brgyad drugamachod bya zhing*/ /pad+ma'i 'dod pa spang zhen pa/ bar bya/ /bdag nyid rang bdag don yod/bsams nas ni/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab sbyor bas| |rdo rje'i bu mo sgrol ma/ cher grags pa/ /rdo rje don yod/nag po lta bus mdog nag po la mchod par bya zer/mchod/ /rang sgrol mar/rig skyes bu bsams rang don yod du/ nas ni/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i rtse brgyad drugamachod pas/ /bu mo de bzhin gshegs ma mchod| |phyag rin 'byung*/rgya'i dngos grub don du mchod/ /rang gi rig ma skyes bu bsam| |rdo rje pad+ma'i rtsa mchod pas/ /gdol pa 'i rigs/chen po las byung ba/ / phyag rgya'i dngos grub don du mchod/ /phyag rgya chen po rab tu sgrub pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs las/ rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de ltar snyoms 'jug byed pa de yang*/nyi de ltar bstan pa de dus ji srid bsten pas 'grub par bstan/ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi ma gnyis kyi cho ga dang*/ /nyi ma gsum gyi sbyor ba dang*/ /de bzhin du ni nyi ma bzhi/ /nyi ma lnga snyoms 'jug giyi sbyor ba yis// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /me tog la sogs de ltar byed pa'i sngon rol du lha dang bla ma la/mchod byas nas/

/bsam gtan gnas su 'dug pa dang*/ /phyag rgya lhan cig zhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje sbyor ba yang dag brtsam/ /rdo rje nyi ma nub pa na// sbyor ba 'di ni yang dag brtsam/ /nyi ma skya rengs zer/shar ba'i dus su ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /'dod chags tha mal pa'i chags pa las mchog tu gyur pa zag med kyi bde ba/ chen po rjes chags pas/ /'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin las// chags chen ting 'dzin gnas nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po rab bsgrub bya/ /shin tu dga' ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //pad+mar rdo rje de ltar byas pas lha gang gi dngos grub thob pa bstan/can bcug nas// rang gi rig rang mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor yin na/ma bdag mar byas/ /de dang lhan cig 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni phyag rgya chen por brjod/ /mi yi bram ze mo la sogs pa/ phyag rgya blangs nas ni/ /de la 'khor snyoms 'jugalo rab tu dbye/ /dri dang me tog mthun byas nas/ /'khor lo snyoms 'jug gi cho ga gom par yang dag brtsam/ / spyan dang bdag ma rang gi rnal 'byor gyi bye brag gis/sgrol ma dang*/ /dkar mo shin tu yid 'phrog ma| |me tog dri yis mnyes/mthun byas nas/ /rdo rje mchod pa snyoms 'jugayang dag brtsam/ /sngags pas de ltar snyoms par zhugs pas/ phan pa rnam snang*/ 'grub 'gyur zhing*/ /phyag na rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ 'grub pa dang*/ /rdo rje nyi ma 'grub rin 'byung*| pa dang*/ /a mi de ba zhes a yod pas/ dam pa'i yi ge 'od dpag med/ 'grub pa dang*| |bdun don grub/ gyi rgyal po 'grub pa dang*/ /thams rigs so so gang bsgoms kyang rdo rje 'chang nyid kyang 'grub la rdo rje 'chang gi rnal 'byor yin na phyag rgya rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar byas te snyoms par zhugs pas so zhes gsungs nas gang bsgoms kyang 'dra ste rdo rje 'chang 'grub bo||cad 'dren pa 'grub par 'gyur/

/chu yi de lta bu'i sgrub pa po yang dbang dang dam tshig dang ldan par dgos par bstan/ dbang gis dang po ste/ /cod pan dbang la gnyis pa'o| |rdo rje'i dbang gis gsum pa ste/ /rang gi bdag po bzhi pa ste/ /ming gi dbang bskur lnga pa ste/ /drug dam tshig rnams pa gsum gyis/pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /bdun spyan drangs pa'i lha la dbang bskur bar gsol bar btab pas spyi bo nas byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur bar bsam/pa bum pa'i dbang gis te/ / gsang ba'i dbang gis brgyad pa ste/ /shes rab dbang las dgu pa ste/ /de nyid rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kun byin te/ zer/ rdo rje sbyor ba yis/ /bcu pa/ kun bzhi pa/gyi de nyid brjod|brtul zhugs brjod/ /ston pa shākya thub/rang gis lung bstan te/ /de 'dir dbang gi cho ga'o/ /slob dang po/dpon smad brnyas zer/par mi bya ste/ /bde gnyis pa/ gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun gsum pa/ la gyi nyes pa brjod mi bya zer/smod pa nyid mi bya/ /sems bzhi pa dang lnga pa/can rnams la gdug cing*/byams pa mi byed pa/ dang*| |skal bdun pa bcu pa/med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /skal bcu gnyis par 'gro bas/ ldan sems can spang mi bya/ /bdag gi brgyad pa/lus la nges mi smad/ /ming sogs bral ba'i/chos bcu gcig pa dang dgu pa'ang gzung*/nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya/ /gzhan drug pa/ gyi chos la smad mi bya/ /bud bcu bzhi pa/med nyid la'ang smad mi bya/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba rab tu spang ba mdor bstan pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// //bsrung ba'i dam tshig gzhan yang bstan pa/ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag 'di bcu gsum pa gcig pur byas kyang btub/tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /bza' ba dang bsrung ba dang gnyis te spyir bstan/rdo rje dril bu mi bskyod pa'i*|'ang gzung bar bya/ /gtsug de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i/tor rtag tu gzung bar bya//

rtag tu sbyin sreg gidagang blugs dbul/ bar bya/ /rtag rdul tshon dang tshogs dang ting nge 'dzin gsum/ tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya| |'byung las dang po pas/ po che la gtor ma

( ka ) sbyin*/ / ( ga ) phyag de kho na rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rgya bcing ba rnam spang zhing*/ /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ /sku sogs|rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyi/la sogs lus kyi las| |rmi lam du yang mi bya zhing*/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma spun zlar zer/ rgan rabs rgan dang bla ma/ phyag 'tshal lo/ / ( kha ) 'di na mar las dang po ba'i rgyas par bstan rtag par rgyun tu sngags bzla zhing*/ /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spangaX*| |rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing*/ /rtag pa ru ni bshad par gyis/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzaṃ bha la las bzhi| la chu sbyin zhing*/ /las bzhi po/rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i mchod rten las la yang*/ / ( ka ) mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /de ( ga ) nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ pho nya mo thams cad dang*| de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gong du bstan pa de rtogs pa'am phyed par dka' bas| rdo rje nges par brjod pa 'di thos nas/tshig 'di dag gsungs pa/sems ngo bo las khyod kyang kun 'gro'i dbang phyug yin/can kun gyi thams cad khyod/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs snang la rang bzhin med par/ su rtogs| |rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sdang bas gti mugamanan rigs/ pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /gti rigs bdag ste sems la lus kyi rgya/mug thams cad zad bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod| |'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor mar gyur gang*/ /phyag 'tshal pha yum shes rab gyi/ rol phyin snang ba la stong pa'i rgya thub la/ / sgyu bud med du snang ba'ang med pa/ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug mnan rigs/pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /gti mug thams cad zad par mdzad/

/rdo rje sems dpa' rigs bdag ste lus la sems rgya/ rgyal po che/ /zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod| |nga rgyal mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /nga rgyal rigs/thams cad zad pa yi/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che/ /'dod chags rdo rje phyag rigs bdag ste 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya/'tshal bstod/ /chags pas rigs/mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /'dod chags thams cad zad 'dod chags/ mdzad pa/ /rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste/ / ser sna rigs bdag ste rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgya/rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba phrag dog mnan gzigs nas/ /phrag dog thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /bdun gyi rgyal po rgyal po che/ /thams cad gzigs la phyag 'tshal phrag dog dang bya ba grub pas kun la khyab pas ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgya'o/ /bstod/ / ( kha ) de nas bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo gyur pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/la gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/dpal kye'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon la/ ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ / slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /'di nyid yid la bsam par bya/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na|de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas dang*// rdo rje chos dang gzi brjid dang*/ /bdun gyi rgyal po'i dngos grub rnams/ /gang phyir de yis gdam ngag gi sgo nas/dka' ba med/ /mig sman dang ( 1 ) ni rkang byug ( 2 ) dang*| |ral gri ( 3 ) rkang 'og bsgrub pa ( 4 ) dang*/ /ri lu ( 5 ) dang ni mkha' 'di 'bring gi mchog go/spyod ( 6 ) dang*/ /mi snang ba ( 7 ) dang bcud kyis ( 8 ) len*/ /gang phyir ye shes rdo rje rtogs pa'i bla ma/ni/ /mnyes pas myur du 'thob par 'gyur/

/ de phyir slob dpon drung so so skye bo yin na yang de'i drung du/gshegs te/ /de bzhin bshegs rnams phyag mdzad do/ /rdo rje dngos po la/sems dpa' ji lta bu/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su gzung dmigs nas/ / phal so so skye bo/pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /slob dpon gyi ni 'chi ba'i/mthar dus su/ /shi ba zhes pa de/ 'jig rten mi gnas pa/ /skyes pa gleng zhing rmongs pa gang*| |de 'di slob dpon/shi zhes smra bar byed/ /byang chub sems la skye shi med pas/ 'chi phal pa la/ ba zhes bya'i ba ni/rnam par rtog pa ste/ skyes pa/gis/ /dag dngos po la/ pa'i gtsang ma/gnas mkha' spyod dag pa'i ye shes la dbang thob pa rnams/su khyer bar byed/ /yang na sa bcu pa thob par 'gyur/bde ba can du nges/ /'dod pa'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur// me tog sna tshogs lag thogs shing*/ /sna tshogs rgyal mtshan byug pa dang*/ /klu yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas sras dang rdo rjer bcas/ /sna tshogs sgra dang sil snyan che/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad sna tshogs dang*/ /dbang gi gnas rnams nyid kyis ni/ /lus sems la skye shi med pas/ las lus gzhan 'gro bar 'gyur| |rdo rje dril bu lag byin te/ /mgo bo'i gtsug tor mnan nas ni/ /rdo rje sdom pa byin nas ni/ /bum pa'i dbang ni bskur nas ni/ /mig la sogs par gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /rdo rje thab khung rab sbyor bas/ /sbyang bar yang dag bstan pa'o/ /nyi ma dag ni gsum pa na/ /rus pa'i phreng ba bsdu bar bya/ /'o ma dri bzang bsang gtor nas/ /de yi mchod rten yang dag brtsam/ / ( nga ) bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de na/ lha dang mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs pa la mngon par dga'o/

/'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma'i drwa ba rdo rje gur rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i sho lo ka brgya tham pa dang gsum bzhugs so/ /brtag pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /spyir/rgyud 'di la sho lo ka stong phrag gcig dang nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhugs so// //shākya'i dge tshul rgyal mtshan dpal gyi phyag dpe 'di/ 'jam dbyangs jo sras bdag gi sug pas bris pa lags/ /dge'o// //'di'i ma dpe gsum rnyed pa mchan bu mang nyung mi 'dra bar 'dug gzhan gnyis ma tshang zhing*/ mi gsal ba dang mchan thag med pa mang bas re zhig dpe skrun rngo ma thogs/ 'di nyid rang blos gang dpog zhu dag byas/ the tshom can 'ga' zhig ma dpe sor bzhag dang*/ la lar dogs rtags re yod pas dpyad par zhu/ tshul rgyan pas// //༄༅/ /de kho na nyid gsum bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i de kho na nyid ni/ spyir rdo rje zhes bya ba tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ chos nyid kyi rdo rje/ mtshan ma'i rdo rje/ thabs kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje/ rdzas kyi rdo rje dang bzhi las/ 'dir mtshon par byed pa mtshan ma'i rdo rje la/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa ni ye shes kyi rdo rje| rtse lnga pa dam tshig gi rdo rje/ rtse gsum pa ma rungs pa skrod par byed pa'i rdo rje| rwa gyes pa khro bo'i rdo rje dang bzhi yod de/ gang yin yang rwa g.yas g.yon gnyis rked pa'i cha dang gsum rked pa zlum po'i mtha' skor du ji tsam yod pa'i thad du bya ba yin pas na/ saṃ pu ṭi las/ cha gsum gzung ba'i gnas gsal zhing*| ska rags byas pa bzang po nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /spyir sor brgyad pa nas| nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bya/ rtse dgu pa'i steng gi rwa dgu ni/ phyogs bzhi'i rwa/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ snang ba mtha' yas/ don grub bzhi yin/ mtshams kyi rwa bzhi ni yum bzhi/

dbus nam mkha' kun tu bzang po/ rtse mo rnam par snang mdzad dag pa'i ngo bo yin/ 'og gi cha'i rwa dgu ni/ ye shes lnga dang*/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin la/ rtse mo chos kyi dbyings bde ba chen po rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin/ rwa de dag chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba ni/ srid rtsi'i sdug bsngal las 'dren pa'i brda yin/ rwa de dag gi gdan zla ba ni/ 'khor ba'i tshad pas gdungs pa bsil bar byed pa'i brda yin/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng ma ni/ byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad yin la/ 'og ma ni lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu/ skul byed/ rin chen klog ma/ lcags sgrogagazhan gyis mi thub ma rnams te/ lha mo brgyad dag pa'i ngo bo yin la/ lte ba zlum po| chos kyi dbyings spros pa dang bral ba mtshon pa'i brda/ lte ba'i thad gnyis su mu tig gi phreng bas brgyan pa ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rgyan nam rol par shar ba'i brda'o/ /dam tshig gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa ni/ steng gi rwa lnga rigs lnga ye shes lnga/ 'og gi rwa lnga ni yum lnga rnam par dag pa'i brda'o/ /gzhan sngar dang 'dra'o| |dril bu'i de kho na nyid ni/ dbyibs zlum po/ ut+pala'am/ ku mu ta lta bu ste/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ zhi ba ut+pal ku mu ta/ /nang gi ut+pal kha bye 'dra/ /tshad med bzhi yi theg pa la/ /rdo rje phyed pas brgyan pa nyid/ /dbus kyi rtse ni ye shes te| |sangs rgyas thams cad 'phro bar byed/ /tshad ni sor brgyad bcu gnyis dang*| |bcu drug bco brgyad nyer gnyis so/ /zhes so/ /nang stong pa ni stong nyid sher phyin gyi ngo bo/ dbus ni rig pa ye shes kyi ngo bo/ sgra stong nyid ston pa'o/ / steng pad+ma 'dab brgyad ni/ phyogs bzhir/ sangs rgyas spyan/ mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ dam tshig sgrol ma'o/ /mtshams bzhir/ nor rgyun ma/ skul byed ma/ khro gnyer can ma/ rdo rje phreng ba ma brgyad rnam pa dag la/ steng du rigs kyi mtshan ma bzhis brgyan pa dang*/

lte ba ni rigs lnga rnams par dag pa'o/ /de'i steng du bum pa ni/ dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i brdar bdud rtsi'i bum pa'o| |de'i steng du chos sku stong nyid mtshon pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zhal te de'i steng gi pad zla dang rdo rje sngar bzhin no/ /rdo rje la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni shes rab la thabs kyis brgyan pa'i brda'o/ /rdo rje dril bu ji ltar blang ba ni/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rdo rje dril bu mi dmigs pa las/ hūm̐ dang*/ āḥlas rdo rje dang*/ dril bu bskyed la/ bdag nyid kyi lag pa g.yas pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ g.yon pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed la| rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing rdo rje blang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe āḥzhes brjod pas dril bu blang*/ rdo rje nam mkha' la lan gcig gsor la snying khar bzhag la dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi'i sngags brjod cing dkrol bas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du grags par bsam/ de nas bstod pa ci rigs par bya'o// //na mo gu ru phreng ba'i de kho na nyid la bdun las/ dang po phreng ba'i rgyu'i bye brag ni/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/shel dang nya phyis mu tig dang*/khams ni dkar po la sogs gzhan/ /zhi ba'i las la khyad par du/ /phreng ba yi ni mtshan nyid do// gser dang dngul dang zangs ma dang*/ /pad+ma'i 'bras bu khyad par du/ /rgyas pa la ni shis pa yin/ /gur gum la sogs dri sna tshogs/ /dri ni thams cad khyad par du/ /mde gu ril bu byas pa ni/ /dbang la yongs su rab tu grags/ /ru rak+ṣa dang lung thang dang*/ /de bzhin skyes pa'i rus pa nyid/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po la/ /bo de tsis ni las kun byed// ces gsungs pa ni phreng ba'i rgyu'o/ /gnyis pa grangs kyi bye brag ni sngags kyi bsgrub pa lnga bcu ste/

zhes gsungs pas spyir lnga bcu shis la/ bye brag tu/ dbang la de yi phyed nyid do/ /brgya phrag gcig ni zhi ba la/ de bzhin rgyas la lhag par brgyad/ /mngon spyod la ni drug cu'o/ /zhes pa phreng ba'i grangs kyi bye brag go /phreng thag dang mdo 'dzin gyi bye brag ni/ phreng thag dgu bsgril/ mdo 'dzin nyis brtseg tu bya bar bshad do/ /phreng ba'i rnam par dag pa'i bye brag ni/ phreng thag dgu ni byang sems brgyad/ rdo rje 'chang dang dgu'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa ste/ lha dgu la sogs srad bu la/ /lha dgus byin gyis brlabs pa yin// zhes gsungs so/ /phreng ba rnams ni 'phags pa dgra bcom pa'i ngo bo'am/ der dag pa ste/ phreng ba rnams ni dgra bcom pa/ /zhes so/ /mdo 'dzin 'og ma mchod rten gyi dbyibs su byas pa ni/ chos dbyings rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo la| gong ma zlum po ni yum chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo/ de ltar na mdo 'dzin ni dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sku'o/ /de yang mdo 'dzin chos kyi sku yi phyir/ /steng du yang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes so/ /phreng ba de rgyu ba'i dus su hūṃ bzlas shing phreng thag brgyud pa ste/ hūm̐ gi sras bus brgyu ba nyid/ /ces so| |de nas phreng ba byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas lag pa g.yas g.yon thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i nang du phreng ba swa bhā was bsangs pa bcug la/ bdag nyid kyi lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje'i rwar bsams la/ de'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma bsam/ de'i steng du hūm̐ la kā lis bskor ba bsam/ g.yon pa pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa sor mo rnams kyang 'dab mar bsam/ de'i lte bar a las zla ba bsam der ā la ā lis bskor ba bsam/ de gnyis kyi bar du bdud rtsi'i sa bon suṃ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi ge gsum bsams la/

yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ā li kā li dpag tu med pa 'thon nas phreng ba la thim par bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms 'jug nyi ma dang zla ba snyoms 'jug āḥdang hūm̐ snyoms 'juga.ā li dang kā li gnyis snyoms 'jug byas pas/ yig 'bru gsum la thim ste gyur pa las phreng bar gyur par bsam ste/ oṃ las mdo 'dzin byung ste chos sku la āḥlas phreng ba dgra bcom pas bskor bar bsam/ hūm̐ las phreng thag lha dgu'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ pa de pa de mahā dzñā naṃ sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha we ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// lha yab gtso che na lag pa g.yas kyis mdo 'dzin nas bgrang*/ yum ni g.yon gyis bgrang ba la/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra war+ngha ya hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun bzlas te bgrang bar bya'o/ /de nas las gang la sor mo gang gis bgrang ba ni/ zhi ba phreng ba mdzub mor bzhag /de bzhin gung mor rgyas pa ste/ /srin lag la ni dbang du bshad| |mngon spyod mthe'u chung la bgrang*/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang lha mo bsgrub na g.yon pas bgrang*/ yab gtso che na g.yas pas bgrang*/ mchod rten la mi 'gom pa'i phyir sgyur log bya zhing bgrang*/ de'ang the bong lcags kyus phreng ba dgug cing bgrang ba'i dus su lha gang sgrub pa de'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'gugs pa'i bsam pas bgrang ngo*/ /ji lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag ni/ kun tu 'od zer sna tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig sprin gyis spro/ /zung ltar rim pa'i cho ga yis/ /sngags kyi bzlas par rab tu grags/ /zhes pa'i don te/ kye rdo rje dang*/ bde mchog yab yum la 'khor ba'i bzlas pa zhes bya ba/ yum las yab kyi sngags kyi 'od zer dang*/ yig 'bru tshur 'khor ba'am/ yab las yum la phar 'khor ba'i tshul du bzlas par bshad de/

de yang tshur 'khor nas bzlas na rlung brtan par 'gyur/ phar 'khor du bzlas na byang chub kyi sems brtan par 'gyur/ zhes gsung ngo*/ /gzhan yang bzlas thabs gzhung so so gang gi lugs su byas kyang btub ste/ bzlas thabs kyi bye brag go /de ltar de rnams dang ldan na dngos grub shin tu nye ba ni/ mnyam gzhag bzlas dang sgom pa yis// 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nyid mi shes phreng ba ni/ /bud med rnams kyi do shal 'dra/ /zhes pa'o/ /phreng ba'i de kho na nyid i thi/ de kho na nyid gsum gyi man ngag rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /'khon grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung mgur bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig gcig pa'i spun grogs la/ /spyod lam rtsing gi dwogs pa yis/ /snying nas bden pa'i gros shig 'debs| |dam chos sgo ru zhugs pa la/ /spyod lam bab col byas pa yis/ / gtam ngan zhing sa bgyid par mchi'o/ /drin can bla ma rje btsun la/ /yon tan mi rtog nyes skyon rtog /bla ma la log lta skyes par mchi'o/ /zang zing nor la zhen ches pas/ /tshe 'di yi 'dod pa phra mo yis/ /mched grogs dam tshig nyams par mchi'o/ /gsang sngags sgo ru zhugs pa la/ /shes bzhin dran pas ma bzung na| |chos kyis dmyal ba bsgrub par mchi'o/ /zab mo'i don gcig ma rtogs na| |tshig tsam bsgom pa ma byed cig /rnam rtog dru bus bcings par mchi'o/ / byas pa'i las la zin pa med/ /don med g.yeng ba phra mo yis/ /thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor chag par mchi'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa la/ /rlung sems dbang du ma 'dus na/ /chos pa bu phrug spel bar mchi'o/ /longs spyod rgyud la ma brten na| |tshe 'dis sos skos byed byed nas/ /don med mi tshe zad par mchi'o/ /da rung lus sems gtan la phob/ /'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po 'di/ /gnas skabs 'gyur zhing 'gro ba la/ /rang rtag tu re ba yid re 'khrul/ /bem rig gnyis dang bral ba la/ /gnas skabs 'grogs pa'i bza' tsho yang*/ /rtag tu 'grogs su re ba yid re 'khrul/ /drin can pha ma rgan rgon la/ /drin la lan gyis mi ldon par/ /bu la dka' thub byed pa yid re 'khrul/ /tsher ma zug pa mi bzod par/ /ral gri rnon po'i nags tshal du/ /bzod du re ba yid re 'khrul// gzer nad dar cig mi bzod par/ /tsha dmyal sdug bsngal drag po la/ /bzod du re ba yid re 'khrul/ /dar cig grang ba mi bzod par/ /grang dmyal sdug bsngal yun ring la/ /bzod du re ba yid re 'khrul/ /nang gcig ltogs pa mi bzod par/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal yun ring la/

/bzod du re ba yid re 'khrul| |lo ka'i long ba mi bzod par/ /gling bar mun pa yun ring la/ / mthong du re ba yid re 'khrul/ /rang re'i so nam mi nus par/ /byol song bkol spyod bsran dka' ba/ /nus su re ba yid re 'khrul/ /da rung rang sems gtan la phob/ /i thi// //༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal bsam na ni/ /skye ba'i tshe na 'di ltar sdug bsngal te/ /ma 'grangs pa yi tshe na ri bos brtsir ba 'dra*/ /ma ltogs pa'i tshe na dpyang la btags pa 'dra| |drag shul byas na brag la brdabs pa 'dra/ /nyal ba'i tshe na ri yis mnan pa 'dra/ /btsas pa'i tshe na tsher dong skyur ba 'dra/ /blangs pa'i tshe na bye'u chung khra yis khyer ba 'dra/ /de la sogs pa skye ba'i sdug bsngal brjod mi lang*/ /rgas tshe 'di ltar sdug bsngal te/ /skra lo ljang pa dkar por song*/ /dpral ba spos rgya gog po 'dra/ /rna ba sgra yi rgyal po 'on/ /dbang po'i dwangs ma mig kyang long*/ / byad kyi gtso bo sna yang zhom/ /mkhur ba khrag gi dwangs ma bskams/ /rus pa'i rgyal po so yang byid/ /sdod tshe sa do chad pa 'dra/ /ldang tshe rtod phur 'don pa 'dra/ kha chu sna chu mig chu gsum/ /gangs chu bzhin du thur du 'bab/ /sems kyis dran yang lus stobs med/ /zhal ta mi nyan dbang yang shor/ kha cig shi rgan shi 'phyis zer/ /shi ba dga' yang shi mi 'dod/ /na ba'i tshe na 'di lta ste/ /lus kyi 'byung ba ma snyoms pas/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa yi/ /nad kyis lus ni shin tu rgud/ /dar 'bol bting yang tsher ma 'dra/ /sngas la srin bal bcug kyang rtsub/ kar bur zos kyang tig+ta 'dra/ /byad la thal ba gtor ba 'dra/ /sna ru srin bal brdzangs pa 'dra/ kha ru snag tsha zos pa 'dra/ /gzugs ni yi dwags rgad po 'dra/ /zas zhim zos kyang dang kha ldog /dang kha 'ong ba chu las med/ / nyin mi bud la mtshan mi bud/

/'chi ba'i tshe na 'di ltar 'dug /mal gyi tha ma 'chi mal du/ /gnyen gyi tha ma ngo 'phrad bkug /gtam gyi tha ma kha chems zlo// zas kyi tha ma dur rgyags za/ /gnyen bdun mang pos mtha' bskor yang*/ /srog bcod pa yi tshor ba ni/ /rang nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs pas bskor/ /bdud nag bzhi yis 'khrid pa'i tshe/ /mgon skyabs byed pa su yang med/ /ji tsam pa yi gos yod kyang*/ khar rje che na ngo g.yogs gcig |ngo g.yogs de yang rgyal pos khyer/ /ji tsam pa yi zas bdog kyang*/ khar rje che na zas gtad gcig /zas gtad de yang gzhan gyis za/ /ji tsam pa yi gnyen bdog kyang*/ khar rje che na ro 'khur gcig /ro 'khur de yang log nas 'gro /rang gi grogs ni dge sdig gnyis/ /de la bsam la lha chos mdzod// i thi// //༅/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe 'di khri gdugs nyi ma 'dra| |'chi bdag grib so 'byung ba 'dra/ /nyi shar tshe la long bdog kyang*/ / grib so byung na long mi gda'/ /tshe 'di g.yang dkar lu gu 'dra/ /'chi bdag ri khyi sngon po 'dra/ /lu gu'i tshe la long bdog kyang*/ /ri khyi byung na long mi gda'/ / tshe 'di g.yu bya sngon po 'dra/ /bdud ni bya khra hor pa 'dra/ /g.yu bya'i tshe la long bdog kyang*/ /bya khra byung na long mi gda'/ /tshe 'di shā bo rwa bcu 'dra/ /bdud ni rngon pa khyi 'khrid 'dra/ /shwa bo'i tshe la long bdog kyang*/ /rngon pa byung na long mi gda'| |tshe 'di sos ka'i me tog 'dra/ /bdud ni dus kyi ba mo 'dra/ /me tog tshe la long bdog kyang*/ /ba mo byung na long mi gda'/ /tshe 'di rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra| |bdud ni khri gdugs nyi ma 'dra/ /zil pa'i tshe la long bdog kyang*/ /nyi ma byung na long mi gda'/ /bu ma nyal longs la rang gis rang la bzhen bskul mdzod| |i thi// //༅/ /mtho la gnyan no dkon mchog gsum/ /'gran gyi do med dam pa rje| |spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs su gsol/

/sems nyid yangs pa'i klong yangs su| |bsam gtan mkhar spe brtsig brtsig nas/ /sa mkhar brtsig par bdag ma khom/ /lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /chos nyid yangs pa'i g.ye thang la/ /nyon mongs tha rgod 'dul 'dul nas/ /pha zhing 'dul bar bdag ma khom| |lo gsungs dang nyams mi 'ga' re shi /gnyis su med pa'i rgyal khang du||rang byung grogs gcig bsten bsten nas/ khyim thab bya bar bdag ma khom// lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /byang khog kun dga' ra ba ru/ /thos bsam dkor nor gsog gsog nas/ /zang zing gsog par bdag ma khom// lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /zur gsum snying gi dbu rtse ru/ /'od gsal sgron me bteg bteg nas/ /mar me 'degs par bdag ma khom/ /lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /sha rus gnyis kyi 'bi 'bi la/ /rang byung gi mchod rten brtsig brtsig nas/ /sā ts+tsha 'debs par bdag ma khom/ /lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /phyi snod 'byung ba rim brtsegs 'di// gzhal yas khang du bskyed bskyed nas/ /lha khang brtsig par bdag ma khom/ /lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /snang ba dkar mdangs shog bu la/ /zhen med yi ge bris bris nas/ /bka' pod 'bri bar bdag ma khom/ /lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /stong nyid thod phor skya mo ru/ /dgra dug lnga dug gsum brub brub nas/ /srog ser byed par bdag ma khom/ /lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i pho brang du/ /bu rig pa'i khye'u chung 'tshos 'tshos nas/ /lan chags 'tsho bar bdag ma khom/ /lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi /phung po khams dang skye mched 'di/ /lha dang lha mor bsgom bsgom nas/ /thang sku 'bri bar bdag ma khom/ /lo gsungs dang nyams mi dga' re shi khyod kyis bltas pas dal bar mthong*/ /nga la dal ba'i skabs ma mchis/ /i thi/ /maṅga laṃ/ /gsung mgur tshan pa bzhi po 'di dpal sa skya'i dpe mdzod du dpe rnying zhig bzhugs pa ltar bkod pa lags tshul rgyan//

//༄༅/ /ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba dang sgom pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la brten nas dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba'i thabs nye bar mkho ba'i 'od zer bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru ye/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rgyas bsdus gang rung song na/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba la gnyis/ bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis/ de la dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor bri bar ma nus na/ /gtso bo ri mo lugs ma rung*/ /rdo rje can dang dus cig bzhag /ces gsungs pas/ bris sku'am lugs ma sogs kyi drung du mchod gtor rgyas par bshams la/ de'i drung du dkyil 'khor bri ba'am| ma grub na maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i rten rus bu la sogs pa bzhag la/ bdag bsnyen pa ltar dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor rdzogs nas bris sku la sogs pa la/ ye shes pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gyis la/ ci 'byor pas mchod la gtor ma gtang*/ 'og nas 'chad pa bzhin/ bdag 'jug gi rigs lnga'i sdom pa blangs pa la bsdus/ slob ma la bya ba dbang bskur ba nas/ tsha tsha'i bar thams cad 'dir bya bar nus so/ /bsdus pa bstan zin to/ /rgyas pa la bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ don dgu las thog mar sa chog ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der ni/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes kun rig las 'byung bas/ rgyas par gzhan nas 'byung ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na/ phyogs der gtor ma rgyas par btang la/ de na gnas pa'i mi ma yin la zhi bas bslang*/ khro bo'i sngags zlos shing gu gul gyi dud pa dang nyungs dkar gyis brab cing drag pos bslang ngo*/ /lag pas mnan la sa gzhi de nam mkhar bsgom pa dang*/ oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor ji tsam pa'i sa gzhi ga dar legs par bya'o/ /sa chog bsdus pa 'di ni bla ma'i gsung ngo*/ /gnyis pa sta gon ni/ gzhung na med pas ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do/

/byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der ni/ zhes pa la sogs pa gnyis kyis shes par bya'o/ /byed na dkyil 'khor byi dor byas pa'i steng du lha'i gnas shes par bya ba'i phyir/ /ci grub kyi thig gdab la/ lha gnas su dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu byas pa la mchod gtor rgyas par bshams te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor tshar nas mdun du 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin lha bsgrub la/ /ci 'byor pas mchod cing*/ gtor ma btang la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i slob ma 'jug pa yan chad byas nas ci bder gnas la/ nangs par spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ bri ba la 'jug go /bzhi pa bri zhing lha bkod pa ni gsum ste/ thig gis bri ba mthong ba brgyud pa las shes so/ /gnyis pa tshon gyis bri ba la/ rgyud nas thig tshon gnyis ka la byin rlabs ni ma bshad la/ ma byas kyang 'gal ba med pas rigs lnga'i sa bon las byung ba'i rigs lnga bskyed la| de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du byin gyis brlab bo/ /bri ba'i kha dog ni/ rgyud las ma bshad kyang*/ mthong ba brgyud pas shes so/ /'khor lo'i lte ba le tshe dgur byas pa'i dbus dkar/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*| mtshams rnams shar sogs phyogs mdog rdo rje'i gdung sngon po/ de'i phyi rol 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu drug po sngon po/ nang dang phyi'i mu khyud gong ras dang re mig rnams mdzes tshon no/ /sgo gnyis ka'i nang phyogs tshon/ rtsig pa lnga ni| nang dkar/ de nas ljang*/ de nas dmar/ de nas ser/ sngon po phyi/ 'dod yon dmar/ pha gu ser/ drwa phyed sngo/ mda' yab dang rta babs ci mdzes/ nang ma la med de/ phyi sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog rta babs kyi phyi rol nas sgo phyed tsam gyis bskor te/ ser po'am/ dkar po'am/ sngon por byed kyang 'gal ba med do/ /thams cad kyi gdan pad zla'o/ /lha ji ltar 'god na/rgyud las/ dbus kyi phyogs zhes pa nas/sgo ba bzhi po bri bar bya/

/zhes pa'i bar gyis rtsa ba'i lha so bdun dgod pa bstan te sku rdzogs pa'am gdan tsam dgod par bya'o| |byang sems bcu drug nyan thos bcu drug rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ khro bo brgyad ( bzhi ) pho nya bzhi/ ( mngag pa bzhi/ ) bran bzhi ste bcu drug de rnams dngos sam| ming ngam/ brda 'am/ thig ler bri bar bya'o/ /phyi'i khor yug la ni/ 'jig rten pa dgod de/ sngags yod pa rnams rang gi sngags kyi dgod/ gzhan rnams rtsa rig gis dgod do/ /lnga pa sbyang ba'i rten dgod pa ni shes par bya'o/ / drug pa rgyan bkram pa la gsum las/ dang po mchod pa ci 'byor pas/ gnyis pa bum pa ni/ mchod bum bcu drug dbang bum lnga/ rnam rgyal dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis| de dag kun la bum pa mdzes pa/ dri ma med pa mgul chings dang*/ kha rgyan dang*/ nang du sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin po che lngaX gzhug pa la ni khyad par med de| mtshan ma med/ rnam rgyal la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dgod/ dbang bum re re la 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /rnam rgyal dbus su dgod/ dbang bum phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga'o/ /mchod bum khor yul gi mtha' na phar snyoms par dgod/ de tsam ma grub na/ rnam rgyal dang dbang gi bsres pa lnga'am/ de yang ma 'byor na rnam rgyal gcig pu la bsdu'o/ / gsum pa ni/ gtor ma 'byor tshad yin na'ang bzhi las mi nyung bar bsham mo// bdun pa bdag gi rnal 'byor bum pa'i bzlas pa dang bcas pa ni/ de ltar dgos pa thams cad tshogs nas bdag nyid khrus byas rgyan gyis brgyan la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung du stan bde ba la bsdad la/ rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ chos thams cad bdag med pa don dam byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sems can thams cad khyad par du tshe 'das pa la shin tu brtse ba'i bdag nyid sngon du song ba'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la dgod snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ci rigs pa zhig bsgom/

de ltar byang chub kyi sems dran pa dang bcas pas cho ga la 'jug pa ni bsrung ba rgyas bsdus gang rung nas bzung nas bdag gi rnal 'byor dngos ni/ dpa' bo gcig las mi bsgom gsung ste/ spros pa la dga' na dkyil 'khor nas 'byung ba ltar bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med de ches bzang ngo zhes bya bas bsgom mo/ /de ltar gang rung bsgoms nas bdag la rigs drug ngan song nas thar ba rnams kyis mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ ched du gtad pa'i bar thams cad byas la/ skabs der bum pa'i bzlas pa ni/ lha mi dgod na rtsa rig bzlas par bya'o/ / dbang gi bum pa la rigs lnga bskyed pa'am/ ma bskyed kyang rung ste/ rtsa rig dang rigs lnga'i sngags rnams bzlas so/ /rnam rgyal la lha thams cad skad cig gis bskyed pa'am/ ma bskyed kyang rung ste/ lha thams cad kyi sngags bzlas so/ / grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha bskyed na lha la mchod la/ de byang chub kyi sems 'dzag cing*/ de'i rjes la zhu ba las byung ba'i chur bsam zhing bzla'o/ /lha ma bskyed na mchod pas btub/ chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam pa las med do/ / de nas yi ge brgya pas brtan par bsams la lha sgrub pa la 'jug go /brgyad pa lha sgrub pa ni/ bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis las/ dang po ni bri ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i skabs ltar drangs la bzhugs su gsol la/ phyag rgya bstan la mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis mchod la 'jug pa la sogs bya'o/ /de bas na ye shes pa spyan drangs pa man chad 'brel lo/ /rgyud 'di nas de gsal lo/ /rgyas par byed na/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor stong par bsam/ oṃ bha zhes brjod pas skad cig gis 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bris pa bzhin pas ches rdzogs pa che ba mdzes par bsam/ de nas snying po tshig tsam gyis lha bskyed pa'am/

spro bsdu las lha bskyed pa gang rung bya'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ dbus su kun rig zhal bzhi pa seng ge'i gdan can sku mdog dkar po ting 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs par bsam/ spro bsdu las bskyed na/ seng ge dang pad zla'i steng du snying po blos bkod/ mtha' rtsa rig gis bskor bar bsams la/ de las 'od zer 'phros te/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pas sems can gyi don byas nas/ tshur 'dus te dbus kyi snying po la thim pas kun rig tu bskyed do/ /de'i thugs khar zla steng du/ dbus su gang bskyed kyi snying po 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin/ mtha' skor du rtsa rig bsams la/ spros nas sems can gyi don byed pa dang*/ 'dus nas gang bskyed kyi snying po la thim nas rang gi skur gyur te/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas bton pa rang rang gi gnas su bkod/ de ltar re mos kyis dgod do/ /de dag gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor 'byin pa dang*/ rdul tshon la dgod pa gnyis ka'i sngags phal cher kun rig nas gsungs/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ mdun du sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ g.yas su rgyal mchog dkar po'am sngon po ting nge 'dzin nam g.yas mchog sbyin gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba bid a/ rgyab tu shākya thub pa ser po chos 'chad kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ byang du rin chen me tog dkar po'am ljang khu ting nge 'dzin nam skyabs sbyin gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams su lha mo bzhi bskyed pa ni/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsā ni hūm̐/ mer spyan ma dkar mo spyan 'dzin pa'o/ / oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī trāṃ/ srin por mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /oṃbadz+ra paṇ+ḍa rī de hi de hi sid+dhi bodhi lo kot+ta raṃ pa swāhā/ rlung du gos dkar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/

/ oṃ badz+ra tā re tut+tā re hūm̐ hūm̐ swāhā/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal 'dzin pa'o/ / de dag gis phyag g.yon sa la brten pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa la sems dpa' bcu drug dgod pa ni/ shar gyi rtsibs bzhir rim pa bzhin bskyed de/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa| dzaḥlas rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ hoḥlas rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ dhu las rdo rje legs pa ljang khu se gol gyis legs so ster ba'o/ /lho'i rtsibs bzhi la/ trāṃ las rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ r+ya las rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma 'dzin pa/ bh+ri las rdo rje rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i mdog can yin bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ ha las rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs bzhi la hrīḥlas rdo rje chos dkar dmar g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ g.yas de'i kha 'byed pa/ dhīḥlas rdo rje rnon po sngon po g.yas ral gri/ g.yon po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /krum̐ las rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor la rtsibs brgyad pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bha las rdo rje smra ba dmar po rdo rje'i ljags 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi rtsibs bzhi la/ kam̐ las rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ ram̐ las rdo rje srung ba ser po go cha 'dzin pa'o/ /k+ṣaṃ las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis mche ba zhal gyi g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar 'dzin pa'o/ /saṃ las rdo rje khu tshur ser po rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis dam tshig gi khu tshur gyis 'dzin pa'o/ /yang nang gi mtshams bzhir/ hūm̐ las mer sgeg mo dkar mo snyems pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /trāṃ las srin por phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/

/hrīḥlas rlung du glu ma dmar mo pi wang 'dzin pa'o/ /āḥlas dbang ldan du gar ma ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje 'dzin pas gar byed pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gra bzhir hūm̐ las mer bdug spos ma dkar mo bdug spos 'dzin pa/ trāṃ las srin por me tog ma ser mo/ me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa/ hrīḥlas rlung du mar me ma dmar skya mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ aḥlas dbang ldan du dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ / phyi'i lha mo rnams shākya thub nas 'byung ba'i sngags kyis bskyed kyang btub bo/ / dzaḥlas shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ las

( lho sgor ) rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa/ baṃ las ( nub sgor ) rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ hoḥlas/ ( byang sgor ) rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lha de thams cad rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ zhi ba'i nyams can pad zla'i steng na/ ta thā ga tā lnga/ rdo rje skyil krung bcas gzhan thams cad sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin khro bo yin no/ kha cig sgo ba bzhi gzhengs pa'i khro bo yin te/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud nas bshad pa yin no/ /de'i phyi rol du mgron thabs kyi lha rnams bskyed par bya ste/ sngags ni rtsa rig go /de la rgyas par byed na lha re re la sngags re re bya/ 'bring du byed na/ phyogs kyi grangs kyi byang sems rnams la gcig rang rgyal rnams la gcig nyan thos rnams la gcig phyi'i sgo ba la gnas pa'i khro bo sogs la gcig khor yug pa rnams la gcig gis bskyed par bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' bcu dru ni/ byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros bzhi shar du/ spos glang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog bzhi lhor ro/ /'od dpag med| zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ drwa ba can gyi 'od dang bzhi nub tu/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po bzhi byang du/ thams cad kyang sku mdog phyogs mdog rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu nyan thos bcu drug ni/ rim bzhin phyogs re re bzhi bzhi ste/ 'phags pa dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu shar du/ rab 'byor/ 'char ka ma 'gags pa/ ko'u ḍi n+ya bzhi lhor/ nye ba 'khor/ rta thul/ ba glang bdag kun dga' bo bzhi nub tu/ ming chen/ nor 'dzin/
