gang po/ 'od srungs bzhi byang du/ de dag kha cig bcu gnyis las mi 'dod do/ /de'i phyi rol du rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni/ phyogs re rer gnyis gnyis/ mtshams bzhir re re ste/ shar du mun pa sel ba dang*/ snang ba brtsegs pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa shar lhor/ lhor dpa' bo 'dul ba/ shes rab mgyogs chen/ ri bo rgyal lho nub tu/ nub tu smra ba'i sgra chen/ bse ru lta bu/ dug chen 'joms nub byang du/ byang du rdzu 'phrul chen ston/ seng ge sgra/ yid myur byang shar du/ de ltar dgra bcom par rang rgyal rnams| sku mdog la nges pa med la/ phyag na po sti dang lhung bzed dang*/ 'khar gsil 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gyon pa'o/ khro bo mngag pa pho nya sogs ni/ phyi sgo'i phyogs su khro bo bzhi/ pho nya bzhi/ mngag pa bzhi/ bran bzhi bskyed de/ shar sgor 'jig rten gsum snang*/ khro bo de'i g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ mngag pa/ g.yon du dus kyi srin mo/ pho nya/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ bran/ lhor 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ de'i g.yas su dbyug sngon can/ g.yon du dus kyi dbyug pa can/ rgyab tu dus kyi zhags pa ma/ nub tu 'jig rten gsum 'ching*/ de'i g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du dus kyi mtshan mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ byang du lo ka gsum 'jig de'i g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du dus kyi gnod sbyin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi dril bu ma/ de thams cad kyi sku mdog ma nges pa/ dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan no/ /byang sems bcu drug la sogs pa sgo nyis brtsegs su byed na nang ma'i khyams su bkod la/ sgo rkyang du byed na yang*/ lha snam cher byas la rim pa gnyis su bya/ nang ma la rtsa ba'i lha so bdun/ phyi ma la mgron thabs kyi lha drug cu bkod/ 'jig rten pa rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan mos pa tsam las gsal por ma bskyed kyang chog gsung*/

rgyas par phyi'i khor yug gi nang na/ khor yug la rtsa rig gam/ rang rang gi sngags kyis lo ka pa rnams dgod do/ khor yug la shar du oṃ dhṛ las yul 'khor srung ljang khu pi wang 'dzin pa/ lhor oṃ bhi las 'phags skyes po sku mdog sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu oṃ k+ṣa las mig mi bzang dmar skya sbrul mgo bdun gyis bskor ba rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang du bai las rnam sras ser po/ g.yas be con/ g.yon ne'u le thogs pa'o/ /shar du oṃ i las brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ thig le 'dzin/ sha rtsi dang thig le mchog gnyis dkar po'o/ /lhor oṃ ya las gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug pa thogs pa/ re ma tī lag cha sna tshogs pa nag po/ nub tu oṃ baṃ las chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du oṃ ku las gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa/ rin po che 'dzin pa/ byang shar du oṃ i las dbang phyug dkar po glang la zhon pa/ rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor oṃ a las/ me lha dmar po ra la zhon pa/ dbyu gu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu oṃ ri las srin po nag po mi la zhon pa/ nub byang du oṃ oṃ las rlung lha ljang khu shwa ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ lhor oṃ a las nyi ma dmar po rta la zhon pa nyi ma 'dzin pa/ byang du oṃ swa las zla ba dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa zla ba 'dzin pa/ byang du oṃ bra las sa bdag phag mgo can ser po pi wang 'dzin pa'o/ /shar du oṃ shu las pa wa sangs dkar po stan nang tshang can la 'dug pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shing thogs pa/ lhor dri las phur bu dkar po zla ba la gnas pa/ g.yas pa posti g.yon pa chos 'chad pa'i tshig 'dren pa'i tshul/ stod g.yogs ser po can no/ /nub tu oṃ pra las zla ba dkar po ut+pal thogs pa ngang pa la zhon pa/ byang du oṃ bhu las/ gza' lag pa ser po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal 'dzin pa/

stan bar tshang can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rlung du a las nyi ma dmar po/ rta la zhon pa/ lag na pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du oṃ pa las spen pa mdog nag po/ rgyan med pa skra bshig pa/ dbyug tho thogs pa stan nang tshang can no/ /shar lhor oṃ las mig dmar mdog dmar po g.yas pa chus gang ba'i bum pa/ g.yon mgal me 'dzin pa/ stan nang tshang can/ srin por oṃ a ra las sgra gcan mdog dud kha shin tu khros pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rked pa man chad sbrul gseb na 'dug pa/ shar du smin drug dmar po bum pa la 'dug pa/ snar ma ljang khu ba dkar mo la zhon pa/ mgo ser po shwa ba la zhon pa/ lag dmar po sbrul la zhon pa/ /nam so dmar po pad+ma la 'dug pa/ rgyal ljang khu bum pa la 'dug pa/ skag ljang khu bya rog la 'dug pa/ byang du mchu ser po me tog la 'dug pa/ gre dkar po pad+ma la 'dug pa| dbo ljang khu khra la 'dug pa/ me bzhi ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ nag pa ljang khu rma bya la zhon pa/ sa ri dmar mo spyang mo la zhon pa/ sa ga ljang khu ra dkar po la zhon pa/ nub tu lha mtshams ser po bya rog la zhon pa/ snron dmar po stan nang tshang can la 'dug pa/ snrubs ljang khu rus sbal la zhon pa/ chu stod ser po stan nang tshang can la 'dug pa/ chu smad ljang khu mi'i snying la 'dug pa/ gro bzhin dkar po stan nang tshang can la 'dug pa/ byi bzhin ser po skud pa la 'dug pa/ lhor mon gru dmar po stan nang tshang can la 'dug pa/ mon gre ljang khu ba la zhon pa/ khrums stod ljang khu gser khri la 'dug pa/ khrums smad ser po gser khri la 'dug pa/ nam gru dmar po rta la zhon pa/ tha skar ljang khu mi'i snying la 'dug pa/ bra nye ser po 'khor lo la 'dug pa'o/ /klu chen brgyad nub 'ba' zhing tu'am/ yang na/ shar du oṃ phu las mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor oṃ pha las 'jog po dmar po/ nub tu oṃ phuṃ las stobs kyi rgyu ljang khu/

byang du oṃ pha las rigs ldan khra bo/ shar lhor oṃ phi las nor rgyas dkar po/ lho nub tu oṃ phe las dung skyong ser po/ nub byang du oṃ phe las pad+ma dmar po/ byang shar du oṃ pho las chu lha dkar po sbrul mgo bdun bdun gyis bskor ba chung mas mgul nas 'khyud pa'o/ /chung ma rnams sku mdog yab dang 'dra ba la/ ut+pal 'dzin pa/ sbrul mgo gsum gsum gyis bskor ba yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /'jigs byed dgu ni| shar du oṃ bhe ra las 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog sngo nag g.yas kyis gri gug g.yon thod pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gling po che'i ko rlon gyon pa/ dbu la thod pa dang zla tshes kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan ma btsun mo la bstan pa/ yum u ma bhe ra bhi swāhā las dka' thub bzlog pa'i tshul sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso bo dang 'dra/ gha ga dkar/ ya mi ni ljang*/ dpal ma ni ser/ 'jigs byed ma dkar/ rdzong gi lha mo dmar/ stobs bzang ma dkar/ ku ma rī dmar skya ci bde ba'i lag cha 'dzin pa'o/ /yang shar du/ oṃ shu swāhā las lha chen khros pa dkar po yum dang bcas pa'o/ /lhor oṃ bhe swāhā las brgya byin khros pa ser po/ ma thig le 'dzin ser mo sha rtsi dang thig le mchog gnyis dkar mo'o/ / nub tu oṃ bhe swāhā las tshangs pa khros pa dmar po yum tshangs ma dang dbyangs can gnyis 'khor tshangs ma brgyad/ byang du oṃ bhe swāhā las khyab 'jug khros pa sngon po nor rgyun dang dbyangs can gnyis ser dang dkar ba'o/ /shar lhor oṃ bhe swāhā las 'dod pa'i lha khros pa dmar po yum dang bcas pa/ lho nub tu oṃ bhe'u swāhā las tshogs bdag khros pa dud kha yum dang bcas pa/ nub byang du oṃ bhaṃ swāhā las bh+riṅgi ri ti khros pa sngo skya chung ma dang bcas pa/ byang shar du oṃ bha swāhā las smin drug khros pa chung ma dang bcas pa'o/ /lha chen brgyad ni shar du/ oṃ ru las dbang phyug chen po mdog nag po/

mtshan ma bsgreng ba rtse gsum thogs pa/ ( lhor oṃ i las brgya byin dkar po rdo rje rtse gsum pa gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu oṃ oṃ las tshangs pa ser po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ ) byang du oṃ bi las khyab 'jug ljang khu/ g.yas 'khor lo dang dung*/ dbyug pa dang rin po che 'dzin pa'o| |shar lhor oṃ kaṃ las 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dkar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa| lho nub tu oṃ ga las tshogs bdag glang sna dkar po lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang la phug g.yon dgra s+t+wa dang la du'i snod 'dzin pa/ nub byang du oṃ gri las bh+riṅgi ri ti nag po bum pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du oṃ ka las gzhon nu karti ka gdong drug ljang khu mdung thung thogs pa'o/ khor yug gi nang du shar phyogs su dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa/ chung ma gnyis/ pho nya gnyis te bzhi| lhor rdo rje'i mchu dang rdo rje'i sprin gnyis smug po/ nub tu sprin gyi sgron ma dmar po rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang*/ sdig mdzub 'dzin pa'o/ /grul bum nag po pho nya gnyis dang bcas pa'o/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzang ris sngon po 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /byang du gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la rgyal ba khyu mchog dang*/ yang dag shes dang*/ lnga rtsen gyis bskor ba'o/ /ne'u le dang bi dza pu ra 'dzin pa ser po'o/ /byang stod du nam mkha' lding lus po bya yi rgyal po gser mig can no/ /shar lhor drang srong rgyal pa dang gar ldan gyi bu gnyis so/ / lho nub tu gau rī dang*/ tsau rī dang*/ ma tang gī dang*/ tsa mun+t+ri/ lag cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub byang du srid mo bzhi ni/ 'dod pa nag mo/ ( 'di'i phyag mtshan chad 'dra | ) phag mo dkar mo thod pa 'dzin pa/ thod pa ma dmar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ grub pa ma ljang khu bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ de'i rtsar ming po gsum po rgyal bar byed pa ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa/ sbrang rtsir byed pa dkar po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/

don kun grub pa dmar po lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o/ /byang shar du rnam pa ma bzhi ni| srin mo nag mo thod pa 'dzin pa/ be con ma nag mo be con 'dzin pa/ / mtshan mo nag mo dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin nag mo mche ba 'dzin pa'o/ / 'byung po chen po bzhi ni lha chen po/ khyim dang ri la gnas pa dang*/ /shing dang kun dga' nags tshal sogs/ /dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa rnams/ /zhes pa phyogs tha dad du ci bde bar bri zhing bskor gsung ngo*/ /de la ye shes pa spyan drang ba'i tshig bcad kyis spyan drangs/ de yang bsdus pa ni/ rdul tshon la ye shes pa spyan 'dren la/ shin tu bsdus pa ni/ ras bris la sogs pa ye shes pa spyan drangs nas mchod pa byed pa 'di man chad thun mong ba'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs la/ thog mar mchod yon khrus stan phul la/ lcags kyu ma sogs kyi mu dra ni/ gsang ba'i bcings pas bcings nas ni/ / mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang*/ /de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du bya/ /mtheb gnyis nang du bcug nas kyang*/ /bskyod par gyur na dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes sbyar la/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas la phyag rgya bstan pa ni gong du brjod pa bzhin lag pa byin gyis brlabs la/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang mu dra bstan cing*| de nas rang rang gi phyag rgya bstan/ rtsa rig dang rang rang gi sngags brjod kyang rung*/ ma brjod kyang rung ste/ rang rang gi phyag rgya bcings la/ sems can ngan song nas 'don pa'i las gzhol zhing*/ rang rang gi sku de la yid kyis legs par rtog pa yin no/ /de la phyogs re mtshon na/ kun rig gi mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcings la/ kun rig gi sku la rtog cing*/ ngag tu bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis sems can rnams ngan song nas 'don pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod par bya'o/

/de bzhin du rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar/ sgo phyi ma'i dus kyi 'bebs ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ de rnams kyi sku mdog la sogs pa nas mdzod cig ces brjod par bya'o/ /lo ka pa rnams la mu dra ston na ni/ phyag rgya bstan la/ de dag gi sku yid la byed pas lo ka pa 'di rang gi yid la ci 'dod pa thams cad 'grub pa'i las dang byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi/ bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i las gzhol bar bya'o/ / de'i phyag rgya ni/ lag pa g.yon gan rkyal du bzhag pa de'i steng du g.yas bzhag pa ste/ mthe bong gnyis ngos gnyis su sprad pa zhi bas lta ba ni/ ta thā ga tā'i rigs kyi phyag rgya ste dam tshig yin par bshad do/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo mtha' bzhi bsgreng*/ gung mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni sbyong ba'i rgyal po'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni/ dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya ste/ rin chen tog gi'o/ /mthe bong dang mthe'u chung mnyam la lhag ma 'bar bar byas pa ni/ sdig pa sreg pa ni shāka thub kyi'o/ /de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba ni las thams cad pa ste rgyal mchog gi'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo rtse sprad/ mdzub mo gung mo'i tshigs dang por btsugs te mig 'dra bar byas/ srin lag mthe'u chung nang du bcug pa ste/ mthe'u bos mnan pa ni spyan gyi'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba las srin lag dang*/ mthe chung nang du bcug kyang rung ma bcug kyang rung ste mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i rwa ltar gung mo la lta ba ni mā ma kī'i rdo rjer bshad do/ /thal mo sbyar la/ gung mo pad+ma ltar byas pa la mthe'u chung so sor phral ba ni gos dkar mo'i pad+mar bshad do/ /thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas dkris te mthe bong gung mo la sbyar/ lhag ma rnams bsnol ba ni ut+pal te sgrol mar bshad do/ /sems dpa' bcu drug gi phyag rgya ni/

rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis gshibs brkyang ba rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i'o/ /sems dpa'i de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa mdun du bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i'o/ /de nyid las me tog gi mda' 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje chags pa'i'o/ /de nyid las slar bkug ste mthe bong gnyis dang rtse sprad pa ni blo gros legs pa'i'o/ /de nyid las tshigs bar ma bcag pa ni rin chen gyi'o/ /de nyid las sor mo lhag ma 'od zer 'bar ba ltar byas pa ni gzi brjid kyi'o/ /de nyid las spyi bor bzhag pa ni me tog gi'o/ /de nyid kha'i thad kar bskor te bzhag pa ni bzhad pa'i'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni pad+ma'i'o/ /de nyid las rtse mo yid tsam bkug pa ni rnon po'i'o/ /de nyid las gdu bu 'dra bar byas pa ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i'o| |de nyid las rtse mo pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra bar byas nas cung zad kha phye ba ni lce smra ba'i'o/ /de nyid las rtse mo yid tsam bkyed pa ni rgya gram las kyi'o/ /de nyid las shin tu bkyed pa ni bsrung ba'i'o/ /de nyid las slar rtse mo gnyis bkug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o/ /mdun du slar bkug pa ni bsdams pa'i khu tshur ro| |nang gi lha mo bzhi ni/ de nyid 'dus pa las bshad pa/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar bzhag /de nyid brkyang ba phreng ba'i'o/ /rdo rje thal mo kha nas dbyung*/ /gar la thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag /ces so/ /phyi'i bzhi ni bsdams pa nyid/ /mdun du bzhag pa bdug pa'i'o/ /de nyid las gyen du 'thor ba ni me tog gi'o/ /mdun du mthe bong gnyis mnyam ste bskor ba mar me'i'o/ /de nyid las byug pa ltar bya ba ni dri'i'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis ka'i rtse mo bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i'o| |de nyid las rtse mo gnyis sprad pa ni zhags pa'i'o/ /de nyid las gcig la gcig mdud pa ni lcags sgrog gi'o/

/de nyid las bkyed pa ni mnyes pa'i'o| |de nyid las phyi'i khyams kyi byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal rnams la rgyud nas mu tra bshad pa med pas rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya lan gsum bstan gsung*/ kun rig gi cho ga kun snying gis mdzad zer ba de nas bshad pa/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba las/ /gung mo srin lag rtse gnyis sgreng*| |mthe'u chung gnyis ni nang du gzhug /mdzub mo gnyis ni bkug byas la| |bcer ba byang sems spyi yi'o/ /thal mo mnyam du sbyar ba las/ /snying khar bzhag pa nyan thos kyi'o/ /g.yon du khu tshur nang bstan te/ /mdzub mo mthe bong nang bstan bsgreng*/ /g.yas pa mtheb srin brang sprad pa/ /rang rgyal rnams kyi phyag rgya'o/ /zhes bshad pa gang grub bya'o/ khro bo dang pho nya spyi dang so so la/ spyi 'dir bstan te/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings te/ gung mo sprad de brkyang*/ tha ma bzhi so sor bsgreng ste/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba las/ de nyid las nang du bkug pa ni khro bo sna tshogs pa'i phyag rgya'o// 'jig rten pa'i phyag rgya ni/ thal mo sbyar ba las dbus ma gsum bkug ste rtse sprad| tha ma bzhi bkyed pa ni pad+ma ste lha'i'o/ /gung mo gshibs pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo ma reg par bkug mthe bong gnyis gshibs pa bsgreng*/ lhag ma bsnol ba ni/ ut+pa la'i ste klu rnams kyi'o/ /lag pa gnyis gshibs te sen mo rnams so ltar gshibs te/ mdzub mo mche ba ltar byas pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o// 'jigs byed 'khor bcas dang srin po'i ni/ g.yas pa'i snyim pa mgo tshal du ston pa ste/ srin po rnams kyi mgo tshal lo/ /sor mo kun bsnol ba ni/ bud med rnams kyi sor bcu bsnol/ g.yon snying khar bsdus te g.yas dbyug pa 'dzin pa ni gza'i'o/ /thal mo gnyis mdun du bkan pa'i srin lag bkug pa ar+gha 'bul ba ste rgyu skar rnams kyi'o/

/lag pa sor mo bcu'i rtse mo bkug ste sprad pa'i snyim pa ni mgo bo'i khar bzhag pa ni phra men ma'i'o/ /de nyid las mthe bong nang*/ lce ltar byas pa mgo thod lce'i phyag rgya'o/ /rnal 'byor ma'i yin par bshad| phyag rgya gong ma legs par bstan pa ni/ rjes sam gong ma dgu po bstan par ma grub kyang rung ste/ 'jig rten pa spyi'i phyag rgya ni/ thal mo sbyar ba bskyod pa pad kor bya ste thal mo sbyar ba kha phye ba'o/ /rang rang gi sngags sam rtsa rig brjod pa'i rjes la phrin las gzhol bar bya'o/ /lo ka'i phyag rgya de dag bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ de rnams kyi sems dga' bas bdag gi dbang du gyur pas bsgo ba rnams nyan par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams ni/ mu dra bstan mi dgos so/ /lha sgrub pa bstan zin to/ /dgu pa mchod gtor bya ba la gnyis/ 'das pa'i lha mchod pa dang*/ lo ka pa la gtor ma sbyin pa'o/ / dang po ni yon chab nas/ rnam lnga sogs las nyi shu pa sogs las/ thog mar bgegs bsang ba nas dbyangs dang bcas pas dbul lo/ /mchod pa rgyas pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer bzhin bya'o/ /'di nas 'byung ba'i nyi shu rtsa lnga pa byed na/ 'di rnams rgyu rin chen las byung bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ glur blangs ba ni thun mong ngo*/ /de la tshan pa bzhi las/ dang po rgyan gyi khyad par brgyad ni/ lus kyis rdo rje khu tshul gnyis las byung ba'i gar bskor ba sngon du song zhing*/ khu tshur gnyis kyis rang gi mgo steng du dbang bskur ba'i tshul du 'jog cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la rin po che'i cod pan bcings par bsams te/ de bzhin du kun la 'gre'o/ /rang gi rna ba la rna rgyan/ mgul pa la mgul rgyan/ brang la do shal/ lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa la dpung rgyan/ mkhrig ma la gdu bu/ g.yas pa'i gung mo la sor gdub/ lag pa g.yas pas g.yas kyi bol la rkang rgyan 'dogs pa'i tshul du byas pa ste rgyan gyi khyad par brgyad do/

/g.yon ta thā ga tā'i khu tshur byas pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo thur du gdugs phub pa'i tshul du byas la gdugs dbul/ rdo rje khur tshur gnyis brtsegs nas g.yon phyogs nas rgyal mtshan phrag la khur tshul lo/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis nam mkha' la 'phan 'dogs pa'i tshul bya/ lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur snying khar bzhag ste g.yas pa'i khu tshur bcangs nas/ mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis brkyang bas nam mkha' la lda ldi 'bul tshul bya/ lag pa gnyis rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul dang*/ lag pa g.yon bsam gtan ltar byas la g.yas pa kha thur du bstan pa bla re 'bul/ yo byad kyi khyad par drug go /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs te seng ge'i gdan 'bul ba'i tshul du bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yas g.yon du drang zhing gzims chas 'bul ba'i tshul/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying khar bzhag ste/ g.yas kyi gung mdzub gnyis kyis pho brang zlum po dbul/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis gzhal yas khang gru bzhi dbul/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis khang bu gru bzhi nyis brtsegs dbul/ khu tshur gnyis kyis zla ba'i gdan dbul te/ gnas kyi khyad par drug go /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis me tog 'thor tshul/ de nyid kyis sgra'i pi wang dang ting shag brdung tshul/ g.yon gyi khu tshur snying khar bzhag ste/ g.yas kyi khu tshur gyis dri'i phye ma 'gyed tshul dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis bshos 'bul tshul/ de nyid kyis gos 'bul tshul te/ mchod pa'i khyad par lnga'o/ /de ltar mchod pa thams cad kyis sam gang rung zhig gis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i sngags pas/ bstod pa gang rung thams cad bya'o/ /bstod pa rgyas pa la dga' ba rnams kyis rgyas par gzhan du brjod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang lha rdzas mchog gi mchod pa'am/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'am/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rig ma bcu drug gam mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa gang grub ky-is mchod par bya'o//

lo ka pa la gtor ma gtong ba ni/ cha gsum dang*/ yi dwags dang rigs drug la gtor ma byin te/ cho ga ni rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bas so/ /cho ga logs su shes so/ /mchod gtor bstan to/ /bcu pa slob dpon bdag 'jug nas/ dbang rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bskur ro/ /de nas mjug gi cho ga rdzogs par bya'o| |mchod rten byas la sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni rgyud 'di nyid nas 'byung ba yin/ de la drug las/ dang po rus chog ni/ thog mar bsreg khang gi drung du phyin/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod cing lag pa bsnol la se gol mang du brdab pa byas la/ rus pa bsdu/ de nas ba byung dang*/ dri zhim po'i chu bum par blugs la/ lhar bskyed cing mchod kyang rung*| rtsa rig mang du bzlas pas chu de byin rlabs can du byas la/ des rtsa rig gi rjes la sbyong ba'i rgyal po'i sngags kyis bkrus la/ zhib tu brdzi zhing bsdu bar bya'o| |gnyis pa 'jim pa'i cho ga ni/ rus bu dang dri bzang po'i chu dang 'jim pa gtsang ma bsres la/ 'jim gong la yang rtsa rig mang du bzlas shing*/ byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gsum pa mchod rten gdab pa ni/ rtsa rig gi rjes la che ge mo'i sdig pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes bya ba gur gum gyis bris la/ 'bi 'bi'i dbus su bcug ste/ lha sku'am mchod rten du rtsa rig bzlas shing gdab bo/ /bzhi pa rab gnas ni/ mchod rten thebs pa dang*/ de dag stong pa'i ngang las mchod rten nyid chen po mang por bsams la/ bum pa'i nang du kun rig la sogs lha so bdun gyi bar skad cig gis bskyed la/ dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su 'byung ba bzhin ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ rtsa rig ci rigs bzlas la byin gyis brlabs la/ ci 'byor pas mchod de gtor ma gtang ngo*/ /de nas mchod rten rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i slar btab pa'i mchod rten gyi rnam par bsams la/

phyag byas la ci 'byor pas mchod de bstod la/ smon lam rgyas par gdab bo/ /lnga pa rtags ma mthong na spogs chog ni/ rtsa rig 'bum phrag brgya la sogs pa bzlas shing mchod la/ mjug tu mtshan thog thag mi nyal bar rtsa rig bzlas na rtags mthong ste 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /drug pa phan yon ni/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags mthong bar nges pa dang*/ lha'i lus su 'gyur ba dang*/ ngan song las thar ba sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ngo*/ /rgyas par ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// mchod rten byas te sdig pa sbyang ba'o/ /spyi don bdun pa rten med pa la bya ba ni/ tshe dpag med las/ kye lha'i bu rnams ngan song du skyes zin pa gang yin pa de dag gi ming la yang dbang skur cig gzugs brnyan la yang*/ mchod rten la yang*/ rang gi lha'i sku gzugs la yang chung ngu na de dang rigs mthun pa dang*/ de'i bu dang*/ de dang rus mthun pa dang*/ de dang ming mthun pa dang*/ bran la yang dbang skur cig zhag bdun du dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur na gdon mi za bar/ zhag bdun nas ngan song gi sgrib pa las grol bar 'gyur ro// zhes 'byung ste/ de'i don yang*/ ro bsreg pa ma yin pa rnams ni/ ming la sogs pa rnams la thams cad bya bar nus so/ /ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ bsgom pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la brten nas dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba'i thabs/nye bar mkho ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbya'o// //༄༅/ /mchod pa nyer lnga bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul/ do shal dpung rgyan gdu bu sor gdub dang*/ /rkang rgyan mu tig phra bkod lta na sdug /rnam brgyad rgyan gyi khyad par khyed la 'bul/ /kun nas zlum po rin chen pho brang mdzes| |gru bzhi sgo bzhi rab brtsegs gzhal med khang*/ /seng ge pad zla gzims chas mchog bzang ba/ khyad par gnas drug 'di dag khyed la 'bul/ / rab bzang bla re rin chen cod pan gdugs/ /nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'phan dang ba dan dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs rnga yab gser yu can/ /rnam drug yo byad 'di dag khyed la 'bul/ /mdzes sdug yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra/ / bsil byed tsan+dan dri dang ro brgya'i zas/ /mnyes 'khril pañtsa li ka reg na bde// rnam lnga 'dod yon 'di dag khyed la 'bul/ /maṃ ga laṃ bha wan+tu/ /shubhaṃ// //༄༅/ /gtor ma cha gsum bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma cha gsum gtong bar 'dod pas/ rgyu ni/ 'bras yos bcas shing til dang bcas// 'bras chan me tog chu dang bcas/ /sran chan bcas shing mang du bya/ /snum 'khur la sogs bza' ba rnams/ /zhes rdo rje 'byung ba las gsungs pas/ de la gsum/ phyogs skyong gi gtsang gtor/ 'byung po'i spyi gtor/ bgegs gtor dang gsum mo/ /de la dang po ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes dri chab gtor bsangs bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gzi brjid bskyed/ oṃ swa bha was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu rin po che las grub pa rgya chen po stong gsum la sogs pa dang mnyam par bsam mo| |oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ ad+ya nud pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas gtor ma'i rdzas rnams 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par bsam mo/ /de nas phyogs skyong spyan drang ba ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/

/thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs dam rgyal ( dkyel ) po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing*/ / phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don gyis mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ye hi da sha dik lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes pas spyan drang ngo*/ gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ / gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po ste/ /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /lha rnams kun dang 'og gi klu rnams dang*/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /swa swa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dges pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas lhan cig tu/ /me tog dri dang gtor ma byug par bcas/ /de dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*| |bdag gis las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /oṃ in+d+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ ag+na ye/ oṃ ya ma ye/ ( oṃ nai t+yā ya ) oṃ ba ru na ye/ oṃ bha ya bhe ye/ oṃ ku be ra ye| oṃ uṣ+t+rī brah+ma na ye/ ( oṃ ī shwa rā ya/ oṃ ur+nghaṃ brah+mā ya/ ) oṃ sur+ya gra ha ye a dhi pa ta ye/ oṃ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ oṃ pṛ thi wi bh+ye/ oṃ ( a ) su re bh+ya| ( nā ge bh+yeḥ ) gh+ri h+ne daṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+ya/ sarba tad khaṃ/ ut+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gh+rih+na daṃ/ bha liṃ ta swāhā| zhes pas phul la bdag cag la bgegs med par mdzod cig

las kyi dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod nas bstod pa ni/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing 'gre= gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag / lho phyogs gdon gyi 'gre= mchod cing = bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ / srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gy-i=mchod cing =zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs=mchod cing bstod de= rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi= mchod cing = gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor skyong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag |byang phyogs= mchod cing = dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar= mchod cing = steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*| |nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing = 'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po pa/ /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod cing = zhes pas bstod de/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya che kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs| |dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams rgyas zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las gzhol la| dngos grub ma lus pa gnang bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa 'byung po thams cad la dbul te/ snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/

lha klu khyad par can rnams kyis gtso byas 'byung po thams cad spyan drang ba ni/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs bcas rnams/ /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ / bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan dgas slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ ki na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod nas sngar ltar gdan dang mchod pa dbul/ dam la bzhag gtor mas mnyes par bsam zhing*/ de wa la sogs pa'i mthar/ na ma sarba ta thā ga tā zhes sogs kyis mchod de/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab gang gnas dang*/ /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*/ /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*/ / ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*| |chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*/ /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang*/ /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong ba dang*/ khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gang gnas dang*/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres gnas dang*/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*/ /lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*/ /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*/ / dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*/ /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang*/ /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*/ /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*/ /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dges shing mgu bar gyur nas kyang*/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas| |bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus phul ba/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*//bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod//

ces bsngos la/ sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa'i sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*| |'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ dpal 'byor rgyas pa la sogs bsams pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don ( gsol ba ) btab nas/ oṃ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ zhes gshegs su gsol| gsum pa bgegs la sbyin par bya ste/ rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ /na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= dge = gsang sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ rig sngags/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs dang*/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma 'di bzhes pa'i slad du/ skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cigaX oṃ guṃ ka re guṃ ka re swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ oṃ guṃ guṃ swāhā/ sarba bigh+na swahā/ zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ e h+ye his spyan drangs/ gṛ h+ne daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ zhes mchod cing*| oṃ guṃ ka re/ zhes pa'i mthar/ na ma sarba zhes bya bas byin nas/ slar yang mchod de tshim par bsams/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*/ /srin po sha rjen za ba dang*/ /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ / ljon shing gel ba sogs gnas pa/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu gyis la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i sems/ /de ring phan chad bskyed par gyis/ /sngon chad mchod pa ma thob pas/ /de ring bdag gis khyed mchod kyis/ /sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang*/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu bar gyis| |dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' dag dang*/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa yis| |gnod par gyur na ma legs kyi/ /bgegs kyi dbang po 'gro bar gyis//

sa bon mngar ba rnams la ni/ /'bras bu mngar ba skye bar 'gyur/ /sa bon tsha ba nyid la ni/ /'bras bu'ang tsha ba nyid du 'gyur/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ sarba bigh+na gats+tsha/ zhes pas btang zhing*/ sum+bha ni'am/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bskrad par bya'o/ /dge ba sangs rgyas su bsngo bar bya'o/ /bla ma rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gtor ma cha gsum bsdus pa rdzogs so// //dge'o// //༄༅/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i skyon bral pad ltar dag pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpes rab brgyan nyi ma 'bum gyi brjid| |rin chen sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' mdzes/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las dang po pa rnams la phan par bya ba'i don du gtor ma brgya rtsa gtong ba'i tshul 'dir bri bar bya ste/ de'ang gtor zan gtsang ma dang*/ gtor snod lnga/ bum pa sta gon byas la/ zan sum tshan gsum dang*/ nyis tshan gcig gis/ brgya rtsa brgyad du byas pa'i thog mar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas sems can thams cad kyi don du mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bdag gis phul bas 'phags pa rnams mnyes shing*| rigs drug rnams chos dang zang zing gis tshim par bya snyam du/ byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ zan dang chu sbyar te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rgyu sbyor bas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/

gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ phyogs skyong ba bcu| rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu la sogs pa/ dpal gtsang ris gyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam la btags shing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ dpal rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas rgya gar shar nub dang*/ bod yul gyi gtsug lag khang dang*/ gdan sa khyad par can rnams skyong zhing*/ bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo| |sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa'am/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa/ rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba mdzad du gsol lo/ /gsum pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa/ dge sbyong dang bram ze/ lha'i drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ tshig tsam gyis phan 'dogs nus pa/ smon lam la dbang ba/ dmod pa 'dor nus pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa/ bdag cag rgyu sbyor ba 'khor dang bcas pa chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon lam bzang po gdab du gsol/ bzhi pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha/ rnam thos sras/ dzam+bha la/ nor rgyun ma/ tshogs kyi bdag po la sogs te/ nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srung skyob mdzad pa rnams la 'bul lo/

/nad dang dbul phongs kyi 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol lo/ /lnga pa/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi gzhi'i bdag po rnams dang*/ khyad par bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ sgos dbus gtsang*/ bye brag tu yul phyogs sa cha 'di nyid la gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha/ klu/ bdud/ btsan/ gnyan mthu bo che rnams la 'bul lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su phebs pa/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ mi nad dang phyugs nad zhi ba/ mu ge dang 'khrug pa mi 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig drug pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gang ba bzang po/ nor bu bzang po/ yang dag shes/ rgyal ba khyu mchog 'brog gnas mched lnga la sogs te 'brog gnas kyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// sems can gyi srog dang gzi mdangs 'phrog pa la sogs te gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ khyad par du bdag cag gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi nas chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la phyag byas la/ bdun pa/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ bdud rigs sum brgya drug cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad bdag rims bdag yams kyi bdag mo/ gdug pa can gnod byed kyi tshogs sa dang bar snang la gnas pa/ 'dod pa'i gegs byed cing*|mi 'dod pa bskyed par byed pa rnams la sbyin no/ /de ring phyin bcad nas sems can thams cad la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub dang*/ gnod cing 'tshe ba ma byed par| gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes nas brtse ba'i sems dang ldan par gyur cig brgyad pa/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim nas rigs drug so so'i bu lon lan chags 'khor nas sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rim gyis rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig

dgu pa/ yi dwags kyi gtso mo kha la me 'bar ma la sogs te/ phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ me lce'i sgrib pa can/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can/ byings na gnas pa/ kha 'thor ba'i tshogs/ bkres skom dbul phongs kyis gdung pa rnams kyi mdun du zas skom bdud rtsi'i char chen po phab nas/ lus sems la phan pa dang bde bas longs spyod cing dga' bas tshim nas/ ser sna'i sdig sgrib byang zhing*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rim gyis rdzogs nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig bcu pa/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la/ tshe rabs thog med nas lan chags pa'i mgron/ bu lon ma 'khor ba/ tshe 'dir yang phog thug can zur la phog pa dang*/ gnod par byed cing bgaX gdon ngos ma zin pa rnams gtor ma 'dis tshim nas/ lan chags thams cad byang*/ bu lon thams cad khyer nas/ gdug rtsub dang gnod 'tshe zhi nas re ba skong bar gyur cig bcu gcig pa/ brgyad bshams la/ gtor ma re zhing skal ba chad pa/ kha zhan pa/ dbang chung ba/ 'byung po glo bur du lhags pa/ lhag ma dang bshal chu la dbang ba so sor ༷rnams kyi mdun du zad mi shes pa'i zas skom gyis tshim par gyur cig des brgya rtsa grub/ mjug tu kha zas mi thob pa'i yi dwags rnams la chu sbyin pa ni/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom/ chu dang snod zan gyis ma gos par bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis chu byin gyis brlab/ phyag g.yas pa'i steng gi rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba nas rgyun mi 'chad par byin pas/ kha 'bar ma dang 'jur 'gegs la sogs pa'i yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad tshim par bsam zhing*|

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes mang du bgrangs pa'i mthar/ oṃ dz+wa la mi daṃ sarba pre te bh+yaḥswāhā/ zhes bsngos nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags rnams ni tshim byas nas/ khrus byas rtag tu bsil bar shog /chu'i sbyin pa rgya chen po 'di la brten nas kha 'bar ma dang 'jur 'gegs la sogs te yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad kyi mdun du zas skom longs spyod kyi tshogs chen pos tshim nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myur du rdzogs par gyur cig ces byas pa la 'jig rten pa'i mgron thams cad la thun mong du ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /la sogs pas chos kyi sbyin pa'ang rgya cher sbyin par bya'o/ /'dod pa'i don rnams kyang bsgom zhing*/ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha zhes se gol brdabs pas mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su byer bar bsam/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ / 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /sems can rnams la byin pa yin/ /don rnams gang du bsam pa der/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur shog /mjug bla na med pa'i byang chub du bsngo/ gnas skabs su bar chad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur ba'i thabs kyi mchog gtor ma yin no/ khyad par du'ang tshe 'di nas bzung ste/ skye ba nas skye ba thams cad du longs spyod chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang*/ nor gyi mchog sbyin pa yin zhing*/ gtor ma la sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi tshang ba'i phyir ro/ / gtor ma 'di byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i don du rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal ldan sa skyar sbyar ba'o// //shubhaṃ// //༄༅/ /rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bden bdar chen mo bzhugs so/

༄༅/ /na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dunagyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis rlabs kyis/ 'byung po'i rigs gang su dag nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams dang*/ sa steng na rgyu ba rnams dang*/ chu nang du rgyu ba rnams dang*/ mtshan mo rgyu ba dang*/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ lha'i gdon/ klu'i gdon la sogs te gdon chen po bco brgyad dang*/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga| zas su mngal za ba la sogs te bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ lha ma srin sde brgyad la sogs pa rnams dang*/ steng 'og bar gsum phyogs mtshams na gnas pa'i 'byung po/ gdon bgegs kyi rigs thams cad bdag la nyon cig bden pa chen po bdar ro// //༈ na mo skyabs dam pa'i gnas/ mgon dam pa'i mchog sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa'i gru rdzings/ ded dpon gyi rgyal po/ gnyan pa btsonaX pa'i bla ma dam pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can| brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ 'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rje can/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thams cad kyi bka' bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs dang*| chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ chos kyi sku sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed par byed pa/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bskor ba'i bka' bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs dang*| 'og min lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnam par snang mdzad la/ sangs rgyas dang sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpas bskor ba'i bka'= mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams nas/ sprul sku bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la/
